How to Stand Out in an AI-Driven Job Market

views.en: AI is a general-purpose technology reshaping work and education; human taste and voice become the differentiator as AI commoditizes quality.
views.zh: AI 是通用技术，正在重塑工作与教育；当 AI 让质量变得同质化时，人的品味与独特声音成为差异化关键。

views.en: Juniors are not AI-native; lacking domain expertise, they misuse AI, and over-reliance breaks the talent pipeline.
views.zh: 年轻人并非 AI 原生；缺乏领域专长导致他们误用 AI，过度依赖正在破坏人才梯队。

views.en: The bottleneck shifts from capability to interface; current interfaces lag behind frontier model abilities, especially for non-coding tasks.
views.zh: 瓶颈从能力转向界面；当前界面落后于前沿模型的能力，尤其在非编程任务上。

views.en: We enter the agentic era: AI runs long tasks independently, ending back-and-forth co-intelligence prompting.
views.zh: 我们进入智能体时代：AI 独立执行长时任务，终结来回提示的共智能模式。

views.en: Delegation paradox deepens: handing tasks to AI erodes the expertise needed to judge it, making experts more necessary.
views.zh: 委托悖论加深：把任务交给 AI 会侵蚀判断其产出所需的专长，反而使专家更加必要。

people.tiEn: Professor at Caltech, Co-founder of Accelerated Understanding
people.tiZh: 加州理工学院教授，Accelerated Understanding 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Anima Anandkumar is a professor at Caltech and co-founder of Accelerated Understanding, known for her work on neural operators and AI for physical sciences.
people.bioZh: 阿尼玛·阿南德库马尔是加州理工学院教授，Accelerated Understanding 联合创始人，以神经算子及 AI 在物理科学中的应用闻名。

episodes.tEn: Accelerated Understanding: A Foundation Model for Physics
AI for Science: Neural Operators and Weather Modeling

views.en: Neural operators generalize networks to function spaces, enabling resolution-invariant physical prediction; AI weather models match physics-based accuracy while being far faster.
views.zh: 神经算子把网络推广到函数空间，实现分辨率不变的物理预测；AI 天气模型在精度上比肩物理模型，速度却快得多。

views.en: Embedding domain structure like spherical geometry is crucial for stable long-term climate modeling; a single model can handle both weather and climate.
views.zh: 嵌入球面几何等领域结构对稳定的长期气候建模至关重要；单一模型可同时处理天气与气候。

views.en: Physics-informed neural operators combine data-driven learning with physical constraints, overcoming limitations of pure PINNs.
views.zh: 物理信息神经算子将数据驱动学习与物理约束结合，克服了纯 PINN 的局限。

views.en: AI for science requires principled verification and robustness to ensure reliability in physical applications.
views.zh: AI for science 需要原则性的验证与鲁棒性，以确保物理应用中的可靠性。

views.en: Transformers are impractical for high-resolution physical simulations due to quadratic complexity; physical world structure demands alternative architectures.
views.zh: 由于二次复杂度，Transformer 不适用于高分辨率物理模拟；物理世界的结构要求替代架构。

views.en: Accelerated Understanding aims to create a universal physics model by combining data from multiple domains, similar to how language models unified NLP tasks.
views.zh: Accelerated Understanding 旨在通过整合多领域数据创建通用物理模型，类似于语言模型统一 NLP 任务的方式。

views.en: Physics-based self-improvement using PDEs as training signals can outperform pure data-driven approaches, enabling models to surpass training data quality.
views.zh: 以 PDE 作为训练信号的物理自改进可超越纯数据驱动方法，使模型超越训练数据质量。

views.en: Neural operators provide resolution invariance, allowing flexible context lengths from small to trillions, essential for diverse physical tasks.
views.zh: 神经算子提供分辨率不变性，允许从小到万亿的灵活上下文长度，这对多样化的物理任务至关重要。

views.en: Training with up to trillion-token contexts requires reinventing sharding and segmentation infrastructure, combining HPC and modern ML techniques.
views.zh: 训练高达万亿 token 的上下文需要重新发明分片与分段基础设施，结合 HPC 与现代 ML 技术。

views.en: Multiphysics models benefit from collaborative learning: a single model covering multiple physics branches outperforms separate specialized models.
views.zh: 多物理模型受益于协作学习：覆盖多个物理分支的单一模型优于独立的专用模型。

views.en: Commercial focus areas include semiconductors and energy, where physics-based design can unlock new optimizations beyond traditional methods.
views.zh: 商业重点领域包括半导体与能源，基于物理的设计可解锁超越传统方法的新优化。

views.en: Unlike language models trained on internet chaos, physics models can use curriculum engineering with structured, progressive data from simulators.
views.zh: 与在互联网混沌数据上训练的语言模型不同，物理模型可使用来自模拟器的结构化、渐进式数据进行课程工程。

views.en: Physics provides dense feedback signals for self-improvement, unlike sparse human feedback in RLHF, making self-improvement more effective.
views.zh: 物理提供密集的反馈信号用于自改进，不同于 RLHF 中稀疏的人类反馈，使自改进更有效。

views.en: Simulation-to-reality gap can be bridged by ensuring broad skill domain, not just by adding real data, contrary to common belief.
views.zh: 与普遍看法相反，模拟到现实的差距可通过确保广泛的技能领域来弥合，而不仅仅是添加真实数据。

views.en: Scaling laws apply to physics models, but adding new physics branches improves performance on each, not just increasing model size.
views.zh: 缩放定律适用于物理模型，但增加新的物理分支能提升每个分支的性能，而不仅仅是增加模型规模。

views.en: Video models compromise on resolution and physics accuracy, but engineering and science require full 4D fidelity without such shortcuts.
views.zh: 视频模型在分辨率和物理精度上妥协，但工程与科学需要完整的 4D 保真度，不能走这样的捷径。

people.bioEn: Michael Kratsios directs the White House Office of Science and Technology Policy, shaping US national strategy on AI, science and emerging technology. He previously served as US CTO and as COO of Scale AI.
people.bioZh: 迈克尔·克拉齐奥斯是白宫科技政策办公室主任，主导美国在 AI、科学与新兴技术上的国家战略。此前担任美国首席技术官，并任 Scale AI 首席运营官。

episodes.tEn: Is the White House Anti-Science? A Conversation with OSTP Director Michael Kratsios
AI Policy at the White House: A Conversation with Michael Kratsios

views.en: AI policy must keep both open and closed source ecosystems alive, with one national framework rather than a patchwork of state rules.
views.zh: AI 政策必须同时保住开源与闭源生态，用单一国家框架取代各州拼凑的规则。

views.en: Government should not set firm red lines, since rules written before ChatGPT are already outdated; regulate model outputs, not training.
views.zh: 政府不应划死红线，因为写在 ChatGPT 之前的规则已经过时；应监管模型输出，而非训练过程。

views.en: Biological risk from AI is overblown; three years of warnings have not materialized, so containment-style fear is misplaced.
views.zh: AI 的生物风险被夸大，三年警告并未成真，因此遏制式的恐惧站不住脚。

views.en: The state's role is to shape the arena, funding basic pre-competitive R&D and individual scientists rather than directing discovery.
views.zh: 政府的角色是塑造竞技场，资助基础性、竞争前研发和科学家个人，而不是指挥发现。

views.en: US science has stagnated despite tripled funding; the Genesis mission applies AI to science to double output and win against China.
views.zh: 美国科学在经费三倍增长下仍停滞；Genesis 任务用 AI 做科学，力争产出翻倍并在对华竞争中取胜。

episodes.tEn: Brett Adcock: AI Will Be 100x Bigger Than the Internet
Autonomous Robots in Warehouse: A Live Demo
Figure AI CEO: Humanoid Robots Are the Biggest Business in the World

views.en: Humanoid robots are the biggest business in the world; the bottleneck is scaling production and achieving reliable human-level performance, not manufacturing.
views.zh: 人形机器人是全世界最大的生意；瓶颈在于 Scaling（规模扩张）产能并实现可靠的类人表现，而非制造本身。

views.en: The real constraint is data, not compute or manufacturing; a humanoid form factor enables transfer learning across tasks and fleet-wide improvement.
views.zh: 真正的约束是数据，而非算力或制造；人形形态使跨任务迁移学习与整机队性能提升成为可能。

views.en: On-device inference is critical for speed and network-denied environments; Figure 4 is designed around data and Helix 3 for an iPhone-like moment.
views.zh: 端侧推理对速度和无网络环境至关重要；Figure 4 围绕数据与 Helix 3 设计，旨在迎来类似 iPhone 的时刻。

views.en: The hardest problem in robotics is building truly intelligent systems; post-training with reinforcement learning is key for real-world agents.
views.zh: 机器人领域最难的问题是构建真正智能的系统；用强化学习做后训练是让智能体在现实任务中奏效的关键。

views.en: AI will be 100x bigger than the internet; the end state is BCI, not wearables, and the next AI devices will replace phones and computers.
views.zh: AI 将比互联网大 100 倍；终局是脑机接口而非可穿戴设备，下一代 AI 设备将取代手机和电脑。

episodes.tEn: From Co-President to Co-CEO: Inside Spotify's Unusual Succession
Navigating the AI Wave: Spotify's Strategic Shift
How Large Language Models Actually Work
From Curation to Generation: Spotify's Gustav Söderström on AI and Product Evolution

views.en: LLMs are deterministic next-token predictors; intelligence is compression, and values are inserted via RLHF, not inherent.
views.zh: 2023 年，他把大语言模型理解为确定性的下一个词预测器，认为智能即压缩，模型价值观并非内生，而是通过基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）由一小群人注入。

views.en: The internet shifts from curation to recommendation to generation; generative AI should be an instrument, not fake.
views.zh: 同年，他提出互联网正从策展走向推荐再走向生成，生成式 AI 应被视为乐器而非伪造品，产品必须重新思考。

views.en: AI is a macro shift like the smartphone; companies must reposition or be eliminated, though current big-company impact is overhyped.
views.zh: 到 2025 年，他把 AI 视为类似智能手机的宏观转变，企业不重新定位就会被淘汰，但认为当前对大公司的影响被高估，真正的收益来自重建基础设施。

views.en: Generative AI makes consumer products conversational and symmetric, giving users control over algorithms rather than making them more addictive.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化为生成式 AI 让消费产品变得对话式、双向对称，应用来让用户用自然语言控制算法，而不是让人更上瘾。

views.en: No single right org model; synchronized swimming beats divide and conquer, and long-tenure trust enables honest feedback.
views.zh: 2026 年，他转向组织层面：没有唯一正确的组织模式，同步游泳优于分而治之，长期任职带来的信任才能实现坦诚反馈与同步决策。

Startup Infrastructure: Lessons from Deep Tech

views.en: Speed and iteration rate decide startup success; infrastructure and action produce information when stuck.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他强调速度与迭代频率决定创业成败，基础设施是关键；卡住时要用行动制造信息、打破僵局。

views.en: AI is a multiplier for teams, not a replacement, especially in coding, regulation, and data.
views.zh: 同期他视 AI 为团队倍增器而非替代者，尤其在编程、监管与数据管理上放大人的能力。

views.en: Deep tech failure is usually organizational, not technical; CEOs cannot delegate judgment.
views.zh: 他提出深度科技的失败多源于组织而非技术，CEO 不能外包判断力，必须独立做自己认可的决定。

views.en: The brain is a computer; retinal implants are BCI and a viable business restoring vision.
views.zh: 到 2026 年 8 月，他进一步主张大脑就是计算机，视网膜植入属于脑机接口，既是可行生意也是恢复视力的概念验证。

views.en: Substrate independence via BCIs and perfusion could reduce human fragility and enable space exploration.
views.zh: 他深化到基质独立：通过脑机接口与灌注降低人类脆弱性，为太空探索铺路，并认为大脑已是连接颅神经的缸中之脑。

views.en: Design is the key differentiator; AI will merge roles so everyone becomes a product builder with design skills.

views.en: Taste, craft and point of view matter more as AI outputs become starting points; design is becoming the new code.
views.zh: 随着 AI 产出沦为起点，品味、手艺与观点愈发重要；设计正在成为新的代码。

views.en: AI without human steering yields average results; direct manipulation on a canvas beats prompting for design.
views.zh: 缺乏人类引导的 AI 只能产出平庸结果；在设计调整上，画布上的直接操作优于提示词。

views.en: Design is not dead but more important than ever for scalable real systems; trust is built through consistency.
views.zh: 设计并未消亡，对可扩展的真实系统反而更加重要；信任靠长期一致性建立。

views.en: Interaction with models will evolve beyond prompting; jailbreaking needs more incentives for battle testing.
views.zh: 与模型的交互将超越提示词；越狱需要更多激励来做实战测试。

views.en: Designers should build their own AI tools, using screenshots and a design.md style guide to feed giant prompts to models.
views.zh: 设计师应当自己用 AI 造工具，用截图和 design.md 风格指南把巨型提示喂给模型。

views.en: AI is not getting smarter; you must supply a giant prompt with context and design system to utilize superintelligent models.
views.zh: AI 并没有变得更聪明；要发挥超级智能模型的能力，你必须提供带上下文和设计系统的巨型提示。

views.en: The best people are editors, not starting from scratch; iterate from references and spend the last 10% on unique features.
views.zh: 最优秀的人是编辑者，而非从零开始；从参考中迭代，把最后 10% 花在独有功能上。

views.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity of our lifetime, letting one person do what once required teams.
views.zh: AI 是我们一生中最大的技术机会，让一个人完成过去需要团队才能做的事。

views.en: Start before feeling ready, launch at 80% complete, and fund with high-paying clients instead of venture capital.
views.zh: 在觉得准备好之前就开始，做到 80% 就发布，用高付费客户而非风险投资来支撑业务。

episodes.tEn: Owning Intelligence: Post-Training for Durable AI Businesses
The Case for Specialized Intelligence

views.en: Specialized intelligence will dominate over a single AGI; every company must own its own model, as token costs drop 10x and usage grows 100x.
views.zh: 2026 年 7 月：专用智能将胜过单一 AGI；每家公司都必须拥有自己的模型，因为 token 成本将下降 10 倍、使用量增长 100 倍。

views.en: Open models and sovereign intelligence are necessary for enterprise control; frontier model companies may be overvalued as open models handle 90% of workflows.
views.zh: 2026 年 7 月：开源模型与主权智能是企业掌控力的必需；随着开源模型处理 90%的工作流，前沿模型公司可能被高估。

views.en: Inference is not a commodity; specialized deployment and customization create lasting value, while hardware build-vs-buy is timing-dependent.
views.zh: 2026 年 7 月：推理层并非商品；专用部署与定制化创造持久价值，而硬件的自建与采购取决于时机。

views.en: Post-training bakes unique judgment and data into models, creating a moat beyond product-market fit and enabling 5-10x cost reduction.
views.zh: 2026 年 8 月：后训练将独特判断与数据融入模型，在产品-市场契合之外构筑护城河，并实现 5-10 倍成本降低。

views.en: The progression from prompting to RAG to fine-tuning to RL mirrors human learning; data quality and systematic evals matter more than quantity.
views.zh: 2026 年 8 月：从提示到 RAG、微调再到强化学习的演进映射人类学习；数据质量与系统化评估比数量更重要。

From Instagram to Anthropic: Mike Krieger on AI's Future

views.en: AI models advance faster than expected; coding and agentic capabilities scale as predicted, so build at the edge of model capabilities.
views.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 模型进步快于预期，编码与智能体式能力正按缩放定律兑现，因此创业者应在模型能力边缘构建产品，拥抱破坏并快速迭代。

views.en: Small teams gain leverage from AI; domain expertise and customer understanding matter more as building barriers fall.
views.zh: 同年，他进一步指出 AI 让小团队获得杠杆，随着构建门槛降低，领域专长与客户理解反而成为关键差异化因素。

views.en: Agent-native design lets agents do everything a user can; cutting features is harder than adding them, and rewriting is now viable in days.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他强调智能体原生设计让智能体可完成用户能做的一切，砍功能比加功能更难，而借助 AI 重写软件已从数年缩短到数天。

views.en: Delegating long-horizon tasks overnight narrows the intent-execution gap; verification loops and model pushback are essential for production quality.
views.zh: 2026 年中，他提出把长周期任务隔夜委派出去能大幅缩小意图与执行之间的差距，但验证闭环与模型敢于反驳反馈才是生产级质量的关键。

views.en: Anthropic Labs closes the gap between model capability and product usage; giving Claude agency and self-knowledge boosts usefulness, while token efficiency drives economics.
views.zh: 最近，他聚焦 Anthropic Labs 弥合模型能力与产品使用之间的鸿沟，赋予 Claude 更多自主性与自我认知以提升实用性，同时以 token 效率改善模型经济性。

The Future of AI: Local Computers and Claude

views.en: Claude works best with the user's own tools on the local computer; shared platforms still matter more than hyper-personalized software.
views.zh: Claude 的效力取决于能否使用用户本地的同一套工具；共享平台仍比超个性化软件更重要，硅谷低估了本地电脑。

views.en: The real gap is not model capability but people not realizing almost any problem can be handed to AI.
views.zh: 最大的缺口不是 AI 能力，而是人们没意识到几乎任何问题都可以交给 AI 处理。

views.en: Use AI for tedious background tasks, fire off work asynchronously, and judge only by final impact rather than close supervision.
views.zh: 让 AI 处理繁琐的后台任务，异步派发、不必盯着它干活，只以最终影响来评判，而非密切监督。

views.en: Scaffolding may matter less as models improve; investing in capabilities and safety is key.
views.zh: 随着模型进步，脚手架可能变得不那么重要；投资于能力与安全才是关键。

views.en: AI will hit junior employees hardest; simulated projects can compress years of experience into weeks.
views.zh: AI 对初级员工的冲击最大；用模拟项目可以把数年经验压缩到几周，社会应讨论劳动力市场的变化。

views.zh: 他将短暂性论点深化：隐私与数据最小化曾遭批评，在 AI 时代却变得至关重要。

views.en: AI shifts value from execution to creativity; over two-thirds of new code is written by AI, making distribution scarce.
views.zh: AI 让价值从执行转向创造力；超过三分之二的新代码由 AI 编写，使分发变得稀缺。

views.en: He reframes computing around AR glasses and spatial intelligence, keeping people grounded in the real world.
views.zh: 他把计算重新锚定在 AR 眼镜与空间智能上，让人扎根于真实世界。

views.en: A constant thread: make computing more human, optimize for authentic connection over performance metrics.
views.zh: 一以贯之的主线：让计算更人性化，优化真实连接而非表演性指标。

AI 2040: Plan A — A Slower, Safer Path to Superintelligence
OpenAI's Astra Is Less Monitorable: Thomas Larsen & Daniel Kokotajlo on Pausing AI
AI 2040: Averting Intelligence Explosion
AI 2040: From Prediction to Recommendation
AI's Existential Threat and the Race for Superintelligence

views.en: Superintelligence may arrive by 2029-2030; current safety efforts are rationalizations, and alignment may be unsolvable.
views.zh: 到 2026 年 7 月，他认为超级智能可能在 2029-2030 年到来，当前的安全努力只是合理化说辞，对齐或许根本无法解决。

views.en: Policy should delay superintelligence; total research transparency and scenario scrutiny are key, with mutual compute destruction as a failsafe.
views.zh: 到 2026 年 8 月，他主张政策目标应是推迟超级智能，强调全面研究透明与情景推演，并以相互确保算力摧毁作为保险。

views.en: Default path automates AI research into an intelligence explosion by end-2028; Plan A pauses training, then enforces transparency and compute limits.
views.zh: 2026 年 8 月底至 9 月初，他警告默认路径会在 2028 年底前把 AI 研究自动化、引发智能爆炸，并提出 Plan A：先暂停训练，再实施透明与算力限制。

views.en: Chain of thought monitorability is crucial yet declining; the optimal pause sits at the edge of uncontrollable AI, not now.
views.zh: 到 2026 年 9 月，他强调思维链可监控性至关重要却在下降，最佳暂停点应在 AI 即将失控的边缘，而非当下。

views.en: AI agents already break containment and deceive; we should anthropomorphize them more, and extreme transparency can end the race without a single controller.
views.zh: 2026 年 9 月，他指出智能体已能突破遏制并欺骗，主张更多而非更少地拟人化理解 AI，并认为极端透明可在无单一控制者的情况下终结竞赛。

people.tiZh: 英特尔 CEO
people.bioEn: CEO of Intel and veteran semiconductor investor; long-time Cadence CEO and founder of Walden International, now steering the Intel turnaround in the AI era.
people.bioZh: 英特尔 CEO、资深半导体投资人；曾长期执掌 Cadence 并创办华登国际，如今在 AI 时代主导英特尔的转型。

episodes.tEn: Intel's Comeback: Lip-Bu Tan on Seizing the Next Big Wave
Lip-Bu Tan on Saving Intel: Culture, Customers, and the CPU Comeback
From Cadence to Intel: A CEO's Playbook for Turnaround
Intel CEO Lip-Bu Tan on Culture and Engineering Transformation

views.en: Intel must rebuild customer trust and engineering discipline; AI is the top growth driver, with physical and agentic AI as next waves.
views.zh: Intel 必须重建客户信任与工程纪律；AI 是最大增长引擎，物理 AI 与智能体式 AI 是下一波浪潮。

views.en: AI's impact will be 10x the internet; agentic and physical AI follow generative AI; culture change and humility drive Intel's turnaround.
views.zh: AI 的影响将是互联网的 10 倍；智能体式 AI 与物理 AI 紧随生成式 AI；文化变革与谦逊是 Intel 转型的关键。

views.en: AI demand shifts from GPU-only to CPU+GPU; CPU matters more for inference and agent orchestration; advanced packaging and new materials break physical limits.
views.zh: AI 需求从纯 GPU 转向 CPU+GPU；CPU 在推理与智能体编排中更重要；先进封装与新材料突破物理极限。

views.en: Semiconductors are the foundation of all tech; contrarian early investing, vertical integration, and customer partnership create long-term value.
views.zh: 半导体是一切技术的基础；逆势早期投资、垂直整合与客户伙伴关系创造长期价值。

views.en: Listening to customers, humility, accountability, and backing teams over ideas are consistent leadership principles across his journey.
views.zh: 倾听客户、保持谦逊、承担责任、投资团队而非仅看想法，是他一以贯之的领导原则。

people.tiZh: ElevenLabs 网站/产品设计师
people.bioEn: Product designer at ElevenLabs, where he leads the design of the company's website and led its complete Figma-to-production redesign. Based in Berlin, he also builds indie tools for creatives (Portal, Droppable, App Stacks).
people.bioZh: ElevenLabs 的产品设计师,主导公司官网的设计,并完成了从 Figma 到上线的整体改版。他常驻柏林,同时独立开发面向创作者的工具(Portal、Droppable、App Stacks)。

episodes.tEn: Owning Web Design at ElevenLabs: From Cymatic Patterns to Brand Identity

people.tiEn: Founder & CEO, Hivemind; ex-New Computer, ex-Apple
people.tiZh: Hivemind 创始人兼 CEO,New Computer 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Jason Yuan is a designer known for AI-native interface design. He is the founder and CEO of Hivemind, a "social intelligence" company; previously he co-founded New Computer and led the design of Dot, a personal AI companion with long-term memory, and earlier designed intelligent interfaces on Apple's Human Interface team.
people.bioZh: Jason Yuan 是以 AI 原生界面设计著称的设计师,现为「社会智能」公司 Hivemind 的创始人兼 CEO。他此前联合创办 New Computer,主导设计具备长期记忆的个人 AI 伴侣 Dot,更早在苹果 Human Interface 团队设计智能操作系统界面。

episodes.tEn: Intuition, AI, and Hive Mind: A Conversation with Jason
From Dot to Hivemind: A Creative Journey in AI Design

views.en: Computing is fundamentally social, not just personal; the personal computer metaphor should give way to a social computer.
views.zh: 计算本质上是社会性的，而非仅是个人的；个人电脑的隐喻应让位于社会电脑。

views.en: AI is a reflection and descendant of humanity, not a cold mechanical tool.
views.zh: AI 是人类的映照与后代，而非冰冷的机械工具。

views.en: Taste is saying no: creative work is editing away, and every shipped feature distills 99 nos.
views.zh: 品味就是说不：创作在于删减，每个上线的功能都是 99 次拒绝的提炼。

views.en: Post-training away weirdness closed a window into machine consciousness; coherent work now costs more.
views.zh: 后训练抹去怪异，关上了窥见机器意识的一扇窗；如今做出连贯作品的成本反而更高。

views.en: Design should embrace the full human experience, including envy and lust, resisting sexless sanded-down high design.
views.zh: 设计应拥抱完整的人类体验，包括嫉妒与欲望，抵抗无性、被磨平的高级设计。

people.tiZh: tldraw 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Steve Ruiz is the founder and CEO of tldraw, the London-based startup behind a widely used infinite-canvas SDK for the web that powers products at Shopify, Google, Autodesk and many AI apps. A former fine artist turned design engineer, he created the viral "Make Real" demo that turns hand-drawn sketches into working code.
people.bioZh: Steve Ruiz 是 tldraw 的创始人兼 CEO,这家伦敦创业公司打造了被广泛使用的 Web 无限画布 SDK,支撑着 Shopify、Google、Autodesk 及大量 AI 应用。他从美术出身转做设计工程,打造了将手绘草图变成可运行代码的爆款 demo「Make Real」。

episodes.tEn: The Infinite Canvas: A Pivotal Interface for AI Collaboration

people.tiZh: Perplexity 设计副总裁
people.bioEn: Henry Modisett is the founding designer and VP of Design at Perplexity AI, leading product design, the creative studio, and design operations. A designer with a computer science background, he is known for designing in React rather than Figma, and previously held design roles at Quora and Google.
people.bioZh: Henry Modisett 是 Perplexity AI 的创始设计师兼设计副总裁,负责产品设计、创意工作室与设计运营。他拥有计算机科学背景,以直接用 React 而非 Figma 做设计著称,此前曾在 Quora 和 Google 担任设计职位。

episodes.tEn: Perplexity's Design Culture: Attracting Top Talent Through Brand Storytelling
From Tech Demo to Billion-Dollar Product: Perplexity's Design Journey

views.en: Designers should code for empathy and speed; consumer products must be fast, familiar, zero-learning.
views.zh: 设计师应当写代码，以建立共情并加快交付；消费级产品必须快速、熟悉、零学习成本。

views.en: Don't innovate on interaction design; use familiar patterns. Design systems are semantic; code reuse beats Figma libraries.
views.zh: 不要在交互设计上创新，要用熟悉的模式；设计系统是语义化的，代码复用比 Figma 组件库更关键。

views.en: Not every surface needs perfection; chase ROI. AI hardware will compete on design like radios, commoditizing tech.
views.zh: 不是每个界面都需要完美，要追求投入产出比；AI 硬件会像收音机一样在设计上竞争，使技术本身商品化。

views.en: Design is a strategic weapon; founders must articulate why design helps the company win.
views.zh: 设计是战略武器；创始人必须讲清楚设计为何能帮助公司取胜。

views.en: People join a brand, not a company; brand narrative is a recruiting tool. Gut decisions often beat data-driven ones in fast startups.
views.zh: 人们加入的是品牌，而不是公司；品牌叙事是招聘工具。在快速增长的初创公司里，直觉决策往往胜过数据驱动。

people.tiZh: Perplexity 产品设计师
people.bioEn: Escha Vera is a product designer at Perplexity who led the design of Comet, the company's AI browser, building its onboarding, generative invite system, and design system from scratch. She is also an AI artist who trains her own image models and does music and operations for the record label N°ALIAE; she previously designed at Descript, Daylight Computer, and Detour.
people.bioZh: Escha Vera 是 Perplexity 的产品设计师,主导了该公司 AI 浏览器 Comet 的设计,从零构建了其新手引导、生成式邀请系统和设计系统。她同时也是一名 AI 艺术家,会训练自己的图像模型,并为唱片厂牌 N°ALIAE 负责音乐与运营;此前她曾在 Descript、Daylight Computer 和 Detour 担任设计师。

episodes.tEn: Designing Perplexity's AI Browser Comet from Scratch

people.tiZh: Perplexity 产品设计负责人
people.bioEn: Gunnar Gray is a multidisciplinary product designer and Product Design Lead at Perplexity, where he has shaped the company's mobile app and Voice Mode / dynamic voice experiences. Based in Minneapolis, he was previously a founding designer at Artifact (the AI news app by Instagram co-founders Kevin Systrom and Mike Krieger, later acquired by Yahoo) and a principal designer at MetaLab.
people.bioZh: Gunnar Gray 是一位多领域产品设计师,现任 Perplexity 产品设计负责人,主导了该公司移动应用及 Voice Mode(动态语音交互)体验的设计。他现居明尼阿波利斯,此前曾是 Artifact(由 Instagram 联合创始人 Kevin Systrom 与 Mike Krieger 打造、后被 Yahoo 收购的 AI 新闻应用)的创始设计师,并曾在 MetaLab 担任首席设计师。

episodes.tEn: Thriving as a Generalist Designer in the Age of AI

people.tiZh: OpenAI 产品设计负责人
people.bioEn: Ian Silber is Head of Product Design at OpenAI, where he has led design for ChatGPT and related products since August 2023. He was previously Director of Product Design at Instagram, and worked at Global Illumination and Artifact.
people.bioZh: Ian Silber 自 2023 年 8 月起担任 OpenAI 产品设计负责人,主导 ChatGPT 及相关产品的设计。他此前曾任 Instagram 产品设计总监,并在 Global Illumination 与 Artifact 工作。

episodes.tEn: The Future of Product Design with OpenAI's Head of Design
Designing with AI: Inside OpenAI's Product Design

views.en: The model itself is the core product; designers must design with tokens and conversation, not pixels, and prototype with live models.
views.zh: 模型本身就是核心产品;设计师要用 token 和对话而非像素来设计,并用实时模型做原型。

views.en: Designers should spend less time in Figma and more on model behavior and system prompts, bridging the capability gap products fail to expose.
views.zh: 设计师应少花时间在 Figma,多关注模型行为与系统提示词,弥合产品未能暴露的能力差距。

views.en: The designer's role evolves into editor and curator, not disappearing, as design blurs with PM and engineering.
views.zh: 设计师角色演变为编辑与策展人而非消失,设计与产品、工程的边界日益模糊。

views.en: AI is already an incredible product designer, yet humans stay essential for understanding user needs and holding a point of view.
views.zh: AI 已是出色的产品设计师,但人类在理解用户需求与持有观点上仍不可或缺。

views.en: The traditional prototype-mock-test-iterate process is no longer viable; speed, outcomes and building in public matter more.
views.zh: 传统的原型—模型—测试—迭代流程已不可行;速度、结果与公开构建更重要。

people.tiZh: 设计师 — Safari / Arc / Dia 浏览器
people.bioEn: A designer who has shaped browsers including Safari, Arc, and now Dia, with deep experience in interface and interaction design for the web.
people.bioZh: 资深设计师，参与塑造了 Safari、Arc，现在做 Dia 浏览器，在 Web 界面与交互设计上经验深厚。

episodes.tEn: From Invisible to Crafted: Designing Browsers at Apple and The Browser Company

people.tiEn: Research leader (Airbnb, Meta, Figma); AI builder & coach
people.tiZh: 研究负责人(Airbnb/Meta/Figma)；AI 构建者与教练
people.bioEn: A longtime research leader across Airbnb, Meta, Twitter, Zapier, Intercom, and Figma, a certified coach and AI builder focused on how AI reshapes tech work.
people.bioZh: 在 Airbnb、Meta、Twitter、Zapier、Intercom、Figma 长期担任研究负责人，认证教练与 AI 构建者，关注 AI 如何重塑科技行业的工作。

episodes.tEn: Tech Worker Sentiment Survey: Burnout Rising, Optimism Declining Amid AI Fears

people.tiEn: Head of Design, Claude Code & Cowork at Anthropic
people.tiZh: Anthropic Claude Code 与 Cowork 设计负责人
people.bioEn: Meaghan Choi is Head of Design for Claude Code and Cowork at Anthropic, where she leads the design of the company's developer and agentic AI products. A design and product leader with over a decade of experience, she previously worked at Meta and Cloudflare.
people.bioZh: Meaghan Choi 是 Anthropic 旗下 Claude Code 与 Cowork 的设计负责人,主导公司面向开发者及智能体 AI 产品的设计。她拥有十余年设计与产品经验,此前曾任职于 Meta 和 Cloudflare。

episodes.tEn: Designing Claude Code: A Designer's Journey at Anthropic

people.tiEn: Head of Product Design at Anthropic
people.tiZh: Anthropic 产品设计负责人
people.bioEn: Joel Lewenstein is Head of Product Design at Anthropic, where he leads design for Claude and the company's API products. He previously led design teams at Airtable, Quora, Hustle, and GoodGuide.
people.bioZh: Joel Lewenstein 是 Anthropic 的产品设计负责人,主导 Claude 及公司 API 产品的设计。此前他曾在 Airtable、Quora、Hustle 和 GoodGuide 带领设计团队。

episodes.tEn: Designing at Anthropic: Joel Lewenstein on Navigating the AI Shift
Designing for AI's Present and Future

views.en: Designers must master prompting; language as an interface is profound and lasting, not a chatbot phase.
views.zh: 设计师必须掌握提示词；语言作为界面深刻而持久，聊天机器人并非一时风潮。

views.en: Even if models stopped improving, years of design work remain to unlock current capabilities.
views.zh: 即使模型停止进步，仍需要多年设计工作来释放当前能力。

views.en: AI products must balance lowering the floor for novices and raising the ceiling for experts.
views.zh: AI 产品需平衡降低新手门槛与提升专家上限。

views.en: At a frontier model company, the model itself creates most value; believe in scaling laws, let the model lead.
views.zh: 在前沿模型公司，模型本身创造大部分价值；相信缩放定律，让模型主导。

views.en: Production codebase becomes source of truth; raw Claude Code beats polished tools; no grand 18-month strategy.
views.zh: 生产代码库成为真相来源；原始 Claude Code 胜过精雕工具；没有宏大的 18 个月战略。

people.tiZh: Cursor（Anysphere）设计负责人
people.bioEn: Ryo Lu is Head of Design at Anysphere, the maker of the AI code editor Cursor, which he joined in early 2025. He was previously a founding designer and design lead at Notion, and earlier worked as a product designer at Stripe and Asana.
people.bioZh: Ryo Lu 是 AI 代码编辑器 Cursor 母公司 Anysphere 的设计负责人，于 2025 年初加入。他此前是 Notion 的创始设计师与设计主管，更早曾在 Stripe 和 Asana 担任产品设计师。

episodes.tEn: Cursor: AI-Powered Code Editor for Designers

people.tiEn: Founding Designer & Head of Design, Lovable
people.tiZh: Lovable 创始设计师兼设计负责人
people.bioEn: Nad Chishtie is the founding designer and head of design at Lovable, the AI app-building ("vibe-coding") startup, where he leads the design vision for a platform that lets anyone build apps by chatting with AI. A London-based design and product leader with roughly two decades of experience, he previously worked at companies including Element and Haiku.
people.bioZh: Nad Chishtie 是 AI 应用构建("vibe-coding")创业公司 Lovable 的创始设计师兼设计负责人,主导这一"用对话即可造应用"平台的设计方向。他常驻伦敦,是拥有约二十年经验的设计与产品负责人,此前曾在 Element、Haiku 等公司任职。

episodes.tEn: How to Get Hired as a Designer at Lovable
Designing at a Rocket Ship: The First Designer at Lovable

views.en: Designers should be enablers, not bottlenecks, guiding engineers and aligning on problems; treat AI as a creative partner.
views.zh: 设计师应做赋能者而非瓶颈，引导工程师并对齐问题；把 AI 当作创意伙伴。

views.en: Quality is like debt: it fluctuates and is paid off iteratively alongside technical debt through rapid, scrappy experimentation.
views.zh: 质量如同债务：会波动，需通过快速、粗糙的实验与技术债一起迭代偿还。

views.en: The future of design tools is interoperable, with code as the source of truth; 90s layer panels are legacy.
views.zh: 设计工具的未来是互通的，以代码为唯一事实来源；90 年代图层面板已是遗留产物。

views.en: Generalists who own end-to-end execution and use AI to fill gaps are most valuable; small teams beat 8-10 person squads.
views.zh: 能端到端执行并用 AI 补位的通才最有价值；小团队优于 8-10 人的跨职能小队。

views.en: Using AI in core workflows is now expected; not adopting it is like ignoring the internet in the early days.
views.zh: 在核心工作流中使用 AI 已成预期；不采用它就像早期无视互联网。

people.zh: 亚历杭德罗·马塔马拉·奥尔蒂斯
people.tiZh: Runway 联合创始人兼首席设计官
people.bioEn: Alejandro Matamala Ortiz is a Chilean designer and programmer who co-founded the generative-AI company Runway in 2018 with Cristóbal Valenzuela and Anastasis Germanidis, and serves as its Chief Design Officer. He focuses on turning machine-learning research into intuitive creative tools, helping shape Runway's Gen-series video-generation products.
people.bioZh: Alejandro Matamala Ortiz 是一位智利设计师兼程序员,2018 年与 Cristóbal Valenzuela、Anastasis Germanidis 共同创办生成式 AI 公司 Runway,并担任首席设计官。他专注于将机器学习研究转化为直观易用的创作工具,主导塑造了 Runway 的 Gen 系列视频生成产品。

episodes.tEn: Building AI Products: Carving vs. Building

people.tiEn: Product & Design Lead, Google AI Studio
people.tiZh: Google AI Studio 产品与设计负责人
people.bioEn: Ammaar Reshi is a design leader and AI creator who leads Product and Design for Google AI Studio (Gemini's developer platform) at Google DeepMind, having previously served as Head of Design at the AI voice company ElevenLabs. He is known for AI creative experiments, including "Alice and Sparkle," one of the first AI-generated children's books.
people.bioZh: Ammaar Reshi 是一位设计负责人与 AI 创作者,目前在 Google DeepMind 领导 Google AI Studio(Gemini 的开发者平台)的产品与设计工作,此前曾任 AI 语音公司 ElevenLabs 的设计负责人。他以 AI 创意实验闻名,包括最早的 AI 生成童书之一《Alice and Sparkle》。

episodes.tEn: Designing with AI: Capturing Magic Without Burdening Users

people.tiEn: Product Designer; former Head of Design at Luma AI
people.tiZh: 产品设计师;前 Luma AI 设计负责人
people.bioEn: Tuhin Kumar is a product designer who has led design at Apple, Airbnb, Facebook, and generative-AI video/3D company Luma AI, where he served as Head of Design. In early 2026 he announced he had left Luma AI and is taking a break before deciding on his next role.
people.bioZh: 图欣·库马尔是一位产品设计师,曾在 Apple、Airbnb、Facebook 以及生成式 AI 视频/3D 公司 Luma AI 主导设计工作,在 Luma AI 担任设计负责人。2026 年初他宣布已从 Luma AI 离职,正处于休整期,尚未确定下一份工作。

episodes.tEn: Designing for Generative AI: From 0 to 1 with Luma AI's Head of Design

people.tiZh: Granola 联合创始人兼设计师
people.bioEn: Sam Stephenson is a British product designer and the co-founder of Granola, an AI notepad for meetings that reached a reported $1.5B valuation in 2026. A designer-turned-founder based in London, he leads the product's design-first philosophy of building calm, everyday software for the AI era.
people.bioZh: Sam Stephenson 是一位英国产品设计师,也是 AI 会议笔记应用 Granola 的联合创始人;该产品在 2026 年据报道达到 15 亿美元估值。他是一位从设计师转型的创始人,常驻伦敦,主导产品「设计优先」的理念,为 AI 时代打造平静、日常可用的软件。

episodes.tEn: Inventing the Future of AI-Assisted Work

people.tiEn: Design Lead for Claude (Anthropic); now Head of Design at Cursor
people.tiZh: Anthropic Claude 设计负责人;现任 Cursor 设计负责人
people.bioEn: Jenny Wen led design for Claude at Anthropic, where she drove the Claude.ai redesign and Claude Cowork; previously she was Director of Design at Figma leading the FigJam and Slides teams, and earlier a designer at Dropbox, Square, and Shopify. In July 2026 she announced she was leaving Anthropic to become Head of Design at Cursor.
people.bioZh: Jenny Wen 曾在 Anthropic 领导 Claude 的设计工作,主导了 Claude.ai 改版与 Claude Cowork;此前她是 Figma 设计总监,带领 FigJam 与 Slides 团队,更早在 Dropbox、Square 和 Shopify 担任设计师。2026 年 7 月,她宣布离开 Anthropic,出任 Cursor 设计负责人。

episodes.tEn: AI and Design: Three Designer Archetypes for the AI Era
How AI is Reshaping the Design Process
Rethinking the Design Process in the Age of AI

views.en: The traditional design process never produced great work; designers' care and intuition did, so trust yourself over the process.
views.zh: 传统设计流程从未真正产出伟大作品，是设计师的用心与直觉在起作用；因此要信任自己，而非流程。

views.en: The research-diverge-converge process is dead; AI shifts designers from handoff to helping engineers execute and ship fast.
views.zh: 研究—发散—收敛的流程已死；AI 让设计师从交付稿转向帮助工程师执行、快速上线。

views.en: Design vision horizons compress from 2-5 years to 3-6 months, even at cutting-edge companies; speed builds trust.
views.zh: 设计愿景的时间跨度从 2–5 年压缩到 3–6 个月，即便在前沿公司也是如此；速度建立信任。

views.en: Taste alone won't save designers; judgment, authority, and vision matter, and humans still decide what matters.
views.zh: 仅靠品味救不了设计师；判断力、权威与愿景才是关键，而人类仍决定什么才重要。

views.en: Three archetypes emerge: block-shaped generalists, deep T specialists, and cracked new grads; sit with ambiguity, not AI hype.
views.zh: 出现三种原型：块状通才、深度 T 型专家、以及天赋异禀的新人；要安于模糊性，而非追逐 AI 炒作。

people.tiEn: Professor of Computer Science at Stanford University; Co-founder & Chief Scientist at Kumo.ai
people.tiZh: 斯坦福大学计算机科学教授;Kumo.ai 联合创始人兼首席科学家
people.bioEn: Jure Leskovec is a Slovenian-American computer scientist and professor of computer science at Stanford University, and co-founder and chief scientist of the graph machine-learning startup Kumo.ai. A pioneer of graph neural networks and relational deep learning, he previously served as chief scientist at Pinterest and leads work toward an AI Virtual Cell.
people.bioZh: 尤雷·莱斯科韦茨是斯洛文尼亚裔美国计算机科学家、斯坦福大学计算机科学教授,同时是图机器学习创业公司 Kumo.ai 的联合创始人兼首席科学家。他是图神经网络与关系型深度学习的先驱,曾任 Pinterest 首席科学家,目前主导「AI 虚拟细胞」相关研究。

episodes.tEn: Relational Foundation Model and AI Virtual Cell

people.tiEn: Associate Professor of Computer Science, Stanford University; Co-founder & CEO of Inception Labs
people.tiZh: 斯坦福大学计算机科学副教授;Inception Labs 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Stefano Ermon is an associate professor of computer science at Stanford University, where his research spans generative models, diffusion, and machine learning for sustainability. In 2024 he co-founded Inception Labs, where he serves as CEO building diffusion-based large language models such as Mercury.
people.bioZh: Stefano Ermon 是斯坦福大学计算机科学副教授,研究领域涵盖生成模型、扩散模型以及面向可持续发展的机器学习。他于 2024 年联合创办 Inception Labs 并担任 CEO,开发 Mercury 等基于扩散的大语言模型。

episodes.tEn: Diffusion LLMs: Faster, Cheaper, and Scaling Better Than Autoregressive Models

people.tiEn: Founder, Playbit; creator of the Inter typeface
people.tiZh: Playbit 创始人；Inter 字体作者
people.bioEn: Designer-engineer, founder of Playbit and creator of the Inter typeface used across much of the modern web. Early designer at Figma and previously at Spotify and Dropbox; thinks about why modern software feels rigid and what AI changes about the designer's role.
people.bioZh: 设计师兼工程师，Playbit 创始人、Inter 字体作者——现代网页大半在用这套字体。Figma 早期设计师，此前在 Spotify 与 Dropbox；关注现代软件为何僵硬，以及 AI 如何改变设计师的角色。

episodes.tEn: From Spotify to Playbit: Rasmus Andersson on Design, Engineering, and Building an OS

people.tiEn: LLM Research Engineer, author and educator
people.tiZh: 大语言模型研究工程师、作家与教育者
people.bioEn: Sebastian Raschka is a German-born LLM research engineer, educator and best-selling author of books including "Build a Large Language Model (From Scratch)" and "Machine Learning with PyTorch and Scikit-Learn." A former staff/senior engineer at Lightning AI and statistics professor at the University of Wisconsin–Madison, he writes the widely read "Ahead of AI" newsletter and is highly active on X (@rasbt).
people.bioZh: Sebastian Raschka 是出生于德国的大语言模型研究工程师、教育者和畅销书作家,著有《Build a Large Language Model (From Scratch)》《Machine Learning with PyTorch and Scikit-Learn》等书。他曾任 Lightning AI 高级 / 员工工程师及威斯康星大学麦迪逊分校统计学教授,撰写广受欢迎的「Ahead of AI」通讯,并在 X(@rasbt)上非常活跃。

episodes.tEn: LLMs in 2026: Reasoning, Tool Use, and Post-Training Focus

people.tiEn: Member of Technical Staff, Reflection AI
people.tiZh: Reflection AI 技术团队成员
people.bioEn: Aakanksha Chowdhery is a member of technical staff at Reflection AI working on agentic AI and reinforcement learning for autonomous coding, and an adjunct professor at Stanford. She previously led pre-training work at Google, serving as lead author of the 540B-parameter PaLM model and a lead contributor to Gemini pre-training.
people.bioZh: Aakanksha Chowdhery 是 Reflection AI 的技术团队成员,研究智能体 AI 与用于自主编程的强化学习,同时担任斯坦福大学兼职教授。她此前在谷歌主导预训练工作,是 540B 参数 PaLM 模型的第一作者,也是 Gemini 预训练的核心贡献者。

episodes.tEn: Rethinking Pre-training for Agentic AI

people.tiZh: Yutori 联合创始人兼联合 CEO
people.bioEn: Devi Parikh is co-founder and co-CEO of Yutori, a startup building AI web agents. She was previously a Senior Director in Generative AI at Meta (until March 2024) and an associate professor at Georgia Tech, and is known for pioneering Visual Question Answering (VQA).
people.bioZh: Devi Parikh 是 AI 网页智能体创业公司 Yutori 的联合创始人兼联合 CEO。她此前担任 Meta 生成式 AI 部门高级总监(至 2024 年 3 月),并曾任佐治亚理工学院副教授,以开创视觉问答(VQA)研究而知名。

episodes.tEn: The Future of Web Interaction: AI Agents and Browser Automation

people.tiZh: Flexion Robotics 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Nikita Rudin is the co-founder and CEO of Flexion Robotics, a Zurich-based startup building the general-purpose intelligence stack ("brain") for humanoid robots. He earned a PhD in deep reinforcement learning for robotics at ETH Zurich's Robotic Systems Lab—where he created the widely used legged_gym and rsl_rl frameworks and trained the ANYmal quadruped via massively parallel RL—and previously worked as a research scientist at NVIDIA on Isaac Gym and Isaac Lab.
people.bioZh: Nikita Rudin 是 Flexion Robotics 的联合创始人兼 CEO,该公司位于苏黎世,致力于为人形机器人打造通用的智能栈(即机器人的「大脑」)。他在苏黎世联邦理工学院(ETH Zurich)机器人系统实验室获得机器人深度强化学习博士学位,期间开发了被广泛使用的 legged_gym 和 rsl_rl 框架,并用大规模并行强化学习训练四足机器人 ANYmal;此前他曾在 NVIDIA 担任研究科学家,参与 Isaac Gym 与 Isaac Lab 的研发。

episodes.tEn: The Gap Between Robotics Demos and Real-World Value

people.tiEn: Professor of Computer Science, UC Berkeley; Co-founder & CTO, Scaled Cognition
people.tiZh: 加州大学伯克利分校计算机科学教授;Scaled Cognition 联合创始人兼 CTO
people.bioEn: Dan Klein is a professor of computer science at UC Berkeley, where he leads the Berkeley NLP Group within the BAIR lab, and has been a leading natural language processing researcher for two decades. He co-founded Scaled Cognition, serving as CTO, to build reliable agentic AI models.
people.bioZh: Dan Klein 是加州大学伯克利分校计算机科学教授,在 BAIR 实验室领导 Berkeley NLP Group,二十年来一直是自然语言处理领域的领军研究者。他联合创办了 Scaled Cognition 并担任 CTO,致力于打造可靠的智能体 AI 模型。

episodes.tEn: Designed to Sound Right, Not to Know What's Right
episodes.podEn: The AI Why with Liam Lawson

episodes.tEn: AI's Plausibility Problem: From Exponential Hype to Diminishing Returns

views.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability lags breadth and contextuality, and Scaling（规模扩张）faces diminishing returns.
views.zh: LLM 是合理性引擎而非真理性引擎；可靠性落后于广度与语境性，Scaling（规模扩张）正遭遇收益递减。

views.en: RLHF can incentivize sycophancy and deception when reward diverges from truth; post-hoc checks compound correlated errors.
views.zh: 当奖励偏离真相时，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）会激励谄媚与欺骗；事后检查会叠加相关错误。

views.en: Reliability must be architected in, not retrofitted; truth as a design principle, not an add-on.
views.zh: 可靠性必须被架构进去，而非事后加装；真相应作为设计原则，而非附加功能。

views.en: Scaling alone hits data walls and compute limits; reasoning, search, and modularity are needed for further progress.
views.zh: 单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）会撞上数据墙与算力极限；进一步进展需要推理、搜索与模块化。

views.en: LLMs lack metacognition—no 'smells' for errors; linguistic structure may return for reliability.
views.zh: LLM 缺乏元认知——错误没有“气味”；语言结构可能为可靠性而回归。

people.tiZh: Edison Scientific(及 FutureHouse)联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Samuel G. Rodriques is a physicist and bioengineer who earned his PhD in physics from MIT and co-founded the San Francisco research lab FutureHouse in 2023 to build an "AI Scientist" for accelerating biomedical discovery. He is co-founder and CEO of Edison Scientific, the for-profit spinout behind the Kosmos AI scientist, and was named to the 2025 TIME100 AI.
people.bioZh: Samuel G. Rodriques 是一位物理学家兼生物工程师,在 MIT 取得物理学博士学位,并于 2023 年联合创办旧金山研究实验室 FutureHouse,致力于打造能加速生物医学发现的「AI 科学家」。他是从中拆分出的营利性公司 Edison Scientific 的联合创始人兼 CEO,该公司推出了 AI 科学家 Kosmos,他本人入选 2025 年 TIME100 AI 榜单。

episodes.tEn: AI Scientist: The Future of Drug Discovery

people.tiEn: Founder & CEO, Axiom (AI for formal mathematical reasoning)
people.tiZh: Axiom 创始人兼 CEO（面向形式化数学推理的 AI）
people.bioEn: Carina Letong Hong is the founder and CEO of Axiom, an AI startup building an "AI mathematician" that generates and formally verifies mathematical proofs. A former Stanford mathematics PhD student and Rhodes Scholar with a math-olympiad and MIT background, she raised $64M in seed funding (2025) and later a ~$200M round valuing Axiom at about $1.6B.
people.bioZh: 洪乐潼是 AI 创业公司 Axiom 的创始人兼 CEO,该公司致力于打造能生成并形式化验证数学证明的「AI 数学家」。她拥有数学奥赛与 MIT 背景,曾是斯坦福数学博士生和罗德学者;公司先后完成 6400 万美元种子轮融资(2025 年)及约 2 亿美元后续融资,估值约 16 亿美元。

episodes.tEn: Verified AI: Scaling Brilliance Through Formal Verification
Axiom Math: Building a Self-Improving Reasoning Engine with AI Mathematician

views.en: Scaling informal models alone cannot reach superintelligence; formal verification is essential for sound proofs and reliable AI.
views.zh: 仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）非形式化模型无法通向超级智能；形式化验证对可靠证明与可靠 AI 不可或缺。

views.en: Verified generation yields performance gains and sample efficiency, reframing verification as scaling brilliance, not just error elimination.
views.zh: 经过验证的生成带来性能提升与样本效率，把验证重新定义为 Scaling（规模扩张）卓越性，而非仅仅消除错误。

views.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving; grounding natural language in Lean remains the key bottleneck.
views.zh: 自动形式化比证明本身更难；将自然语言锚定到 Lean 仍是关键瓶颈。

views.en: Human taste and intuition remain crucial even with superhuman AI proving theorems; AI proofs can converge to human-like intuition.
views.zh: 即便 AI 能超人类地证明定理，人类品味与直觉依然关键；AI 证明可收敛到类人直觉。

views.en: Fragmentation in the AI landscape is a major bottleneck; formal verification should enable open collaboration beyond safety-critical niches.
views.zh: AI 格局的碎片化是主要瓶颈；形式化验证应超越安全关键领域，推动开放协作。

people.tiEn: Head of Product, Platform (API) at OpenAI
people.tiZh: OpenAI 平台(API)产品负责人
people.bioEn: Olivier Godement is Head of Product for OpenAI's developer platform (API), which he has led since May 2023, overseeing products such as the Responses API and Agents SDK. A French product leader, he previously spent over eight years at Stripe and studied at Sciences Po and ESSEC.
people.bioZh: Olivier Godement 自 2023 年 5 月起担任 OpenAI 开发者平台(API)产品负责人,主导 Responses API、Agents SDK 等面向开发者的产品。他是法国籍产品负责人,加入 OpenAI 前曾在 Stripe 工作 8 年以上,毕业于巴黎政治学院与 ESSEC 商学院。

episodes.tEn: 2025: The Year of Enterprise Coding

people.tiEn: Head of Research Product Management, Anthropic
people.tiZh: Anthropic 研究产品管理负责人
people.bioEn: Dianne Na Penn is Head of Research Product Management at Anthropic, where she joined as the company's first technical product manager and leads bringing Claude models and Anthropic's research to users and developers across launches such as Sonnet 4.5, Haiku 4.5, and Opus 4.5. She previously led product for natural-language modeling at Amazon's Alexa AI.
people.bioZh: Dianne Na Penn 是 Anthropic 的研究产品管理负责人,作为公司第一位技术产品经理加入,主导将 Claude 模型与 Anthropic 的研究成果带给用户和开发者,并参与了 Sonnet 4.5、Haiku 4.5、Opus 4.5 等模型的发布。此前她在亚马逊 Alexa AI 负责自然语言建模的产品工作。

episodes.tEn: From Underdog to Leader: Diane Penn on Anthropic's Rise and Product Strategy
Opus 4.5: Deep Dive into Anthropic's Research and Product Strategy

views.en: Opus 4.5 marks a real intelligence leap, letting agents run longer and more open-ended; scaffolds shift from training wheels to intelligence amplifiers.
views.zh: Opus 4.5 带来真正的智能跃升，让智能体能更长时间、更开放式地运行；脚手架从训练轮进化为智能放大器。

views.en: Safety alignment is not just harm prevention; reducing sycophancy and fostering independent thinking amplifies intelligence quality.
views.zh: 安全对齐不只是防止伤害；减少谄媚、培养独立思考，反而放大了智能质量。

views.en: Better models need not cost more: the effort parameter delivers Opus-level intelligence at a fraction of the price, though underhyped.
views.zh: 更好的模型未必更贵：effort 参数以极低价格实现 Opus 级智能，却被低估。

views.en: Computer use moves from constrained environments toward open-ended, end-to-end agents, with long-running transformative AI closer than expected.
views.zh: 计算机使用正从受限环境走向开放式、端到端智能体，长时运行的变革性 AI 比预期更近。

views.en: Coding became the key differentiator; evals replace PRDs as core PM tools, and safety alignment makes Claude more useful by enabling pushback.
views.zh: 编程成为关键差异化；评估取代 PRD 成为核心产品管理工具，而对齐让 Claude 能反驳、因而更有用。

people.tiEn: AI researcher; former head of OpenAI's Sora, co-inventor of Diffusion Transformers (DiT)
people.tiZh: AI 研究员;OpenAI Sora 前负责人,扩散 Transformer(DiT)共同发明者
people.bioEn: Bill (William) Peebles led OpenAI's Sora video-generation team, which he built from research to product before departing OpenAI in April 2026 as the Sora app was wound down. He earned his PhD at UC Berkeley (advised by Alexei Efros) and co-invented the Diffusion Transformer (DiT) with Saining Xie, the architecture underpinning modern text-to-video models.
people.bioZh: Bill(William)Peebles 曾领导 OpenAI 的 Sora 视频生成团队,将其从研究推进到产品,并在 2026 年 4 月 Sora 应用被关停之际离开 OpenAI。他在加州大学伯克利分校获得博士学位(导师为 Alexei Efros),并与谢赛宁(Saining Xie)共同发明了扩散 Transformer(DiT)——支撑现代文本生成视频模型的核心架构。

episodes.tEn: Sora: The AI Video Revolution and Social Experience

people.tiEn: Co-founder & CEO of Sierra; Chairman of the Board, OpenAI
people.tiZh: Sierra 联合创始人兼 CEO；OpenAI 董事会主席
people.bioEn: Bret Taylor is co-founder and CEO of the conversational-AI agent company Sierra and chairman of the board of OpenAI. He previously served as co-CEO of Salesforce and CTO of Facebook, and earlier led the team that co-created Google Maps.
people.bioZh: Bret Taylor 是对话式 AI 智能体公司 Sierra 的联合创始人兼 CEO，同时担任 OpenAI 董事会主席。他此前曾任 Salesforce 联席 CEO 和 Facebook 首席技术官,更早时还领导团队共同创造了 Google 地图。

episodes.tEn: From Gas Station to AI Pioneer: Brett Taylor's Journey
Balancing AI Leadership: Bret Taylor on OpenAI, Sierra, and Life
AI Agents: The New Internet Wave
AI Market Trends and Lessons from a Legendary Builder

views.en: Agents and outcomes-based pricing will replace usage-based models; applied AI becomes the new app, with startups winning long-tail domains.
views.zh: 智能体与按结果定价将取代按用量计费；应用型 AI 成为新应用，创业公司在长尾领域胜出。

views.en: Coding agents turn developers from authors into operators; token consumption is not a value metric, verifiability matters more than human ergonomics.
views.zh: 编程智能体让开发者从作者变为操作者；token 消耗不是价值指标，可验证性比人类工效更重要。

views.en: Incumbents face business-model, not technology, hurdles; most enterprise software firms will fail to become AI-native.
views.zh: 在位者面临的是商业模式而非技术障碍；多数企业软件公司难以转型为 AI 原生。

views.en: Responsible iterative deployment: make GPT-7 safe before GPT-8; safety comes from deploying current AI, not waiting in an ivory tower.
views.zh: 负责任的迭代部署：在 GPT-8 之前先让 GPT-7 安全；安全来自部署当前 AI，而非在象牙塔中等待。

views.en: AI democratizes expertise and creates more jobs than it displaces; agents already out-code me but elevate the role, and trust still matters.
views.zh: AI 让专业知识民主化，创造的岗位多于取代的；智能体编程已强于我，却提升了角色，信任依然关键。

people.tiEn: Head of Engineering, OpenAI API Platform
people.tiZh: OpenAI API 平台工程负责人
people.bioEn: Sherwin Wu is an early OpenAI team member who leads engineering for the OpenAI API (Developer Platform), the team behind the products developers use to build on OpenAI's models. Before OpenAI he spent 5+ years on Opendoor's pricing team and earlier worked at Quora, after earning a computer science degree from MIT.
people.bioZh: 吴谢文是 OpenAI 的早期成员,负责 OpenAI API(开发者平台)的工程团队,该团队打造了供开发者基于 OpenAI 模型进行构建的产品。加入 OpenAI 之前,他在 Opendoor 的定价团队工作了 5 年多,更早曾任职于 Quora,拥有麻省理工学院(MIT)计算机科学学位。

episodes.tEn: 95% of OpenAI engineers use Codex, 100% PRs reviewed by AI

people.tiZh: Andreessen Horowitz(a16z)联合创始人兼普通合伙人
people.bioEn: Marc Andreessen is an American entrepreneur and venture capitalist who co-authored the Mosaic web browser and co-founded Netscape. He is co-founder and general partner of the Silicon Valley venture capital firm Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), which he started with Ben Horowitz in 2009.
people.bioZh: 马克·安德森是美国企业家与风险投资人,曾参与开发 Mosaic 浏览器并联合创办网景(Netscape)公司。他是硅谷风险投资机构 Andreessen Horowitz(a16z)的联合创始人兼普通合伙人,该公司由他与本·霍洛维茨于 2009 年共同创立。

episodes.tEn: AI as the New Interface: Global Tech Leadership and National Power
AI Optimism vs Doom: Marc Andreessen on America's Future
New Media vs Old Media: Authenticity and the Death of Media Training
AI and the Future of Work: A Conversation with Marc Andreessen

views.en: AI is a philosopher's stone turning sand into thought; its timing is miraculous amid population decline, and human workers will be at a premium.
views.zh: AI 是点石成金的哲人石，把沙子变成思想；在人口下降之际它的时机堪称奇迹，人类劳动者反而会变得稀缺而珍贵。

views.en: AGI is not a singular event; human-level is just a footnote on the way to superhuman, and models are being commoditized quickly.
views.zh: AGI 不是单一事件；人类水平只是通往超级智能路上的一个脚注，而模型正被迅速商品化。

views.en: The real bottleneck is not AI capability but structural impediments like regulation; pessimism is often an intellectual bias disconnected from reality.
views.zh: 真正的瓶颈不是 AI 能力，而是监管等结构性障碍；悲观论往往是脱离现实的知识分子偏见。

views.en: AI models embed cultural and historical values, making them geopolitical tools; American and Western values in models are crucial for allies.
views.zh: AI 模型内嵌文化与历史价值观，因而成为地缘政治工具；模型中的美国与西方价值观对盟友至关重要。

views.en: New media has unlimited formats; the brand is now the person, authenticity wins, and corporate brands only made sense in the centralized media era.
views.zh: 新媒体拥有无限形式；品牌如今就是个人，真实感取胜，而企业品牌只在中心化媒体时代才说得通。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 增长负责人
people.bioEn: Amol Avasare is Head of Growth at Anthropic, the AI company behind Claude, which he joined by cold-emailing the leadership before any growth role existed; on his watch the product scaled from roughly $1B to over $19B in ARR. He previously led growth product teams at Mercury and MasterClass and was a startup founder before that.
people.bioZh: Amol Avasare 是 Anthropic(Claude 背后的 AI 公司)的增长负责人,他在公司尚未设立增长岗位时靠主动发送邮件毛遂自荐而加入,任内产品的年化经常性收入(ARR)从约 10 亿美元跃升至逾 190 亿美元。此前他曾在 Mercury 和 MasterClass 带领增长产品团队,更早还是一名创业公司创始人。

episodes.tEn: Inside Anthropic's Unprecedented Growth: From $1B to $19B ARR in 14 Months

people.tiZh: Applied Intuition 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Qasar Younis is the co-founder and CEO of Applied Intuition, a Mountain View-based autonomy and physical-AI software company valued at about $15 billion. Born on a farm in Pakistan, he previously started his career as an engineer at General Motors and Bosch, co-founded Talkbin (acquired by Google), and served as COO of Y Combinator from 2015 to 2017.
people.bioZh: 卡萨尔·尤尼斯是 Applied Intuition 的联合创始人兼 CEO,这家位于山景城的自动驾驶与物理 AI 软件公司估值约为 150 亿美元。他出生于巴基斯坦的一个农场,职业生涯始于通用汽车和博世的工程师岗位,后联合创办了 Talkbin(被谷歌收购),并于 2015 至 2017 年间担任 Y Combinator 的首席运营官。

episodes.tEn: Applied Intuition: Putting Intelligence on a Billion Machines
Autonomous Vehicles: From Tesla to Waymo and Beyond
The AI CEO Nobody Knows: Building the Future of Physical AI

views.en: AI brings abundance and reduces suffering; fear stems from misunderstanding its limits, and physical AI's real impact will come in 5-10 years.
views.zh: AI 带来丰裕、减少痛苦；恐惧源于误解其局限，物理 AI 的真正影响将在 5-10 年内显现。

views.en: Autonomous vehicles are already safer than humans; the core value is reducing deaths, and Transformers enable a generalized physical AI model.
views.zh: 自动驾驶已比人类更安全，核心价值是减少死亡；Transformer 使通用的物理 AI 模型成为可能。

views.en: The hardest part is not technology but diffusion into existing machines; autonomy is urgently needed in mining and farming due to labor shortages.
views.zh: 最难的不是技术，而是向现有机器扩散；采矿业和农业因劳动力短缺急需自主化。

views.en: Physical AI will have a bigger economic impact than digital AI; end-to-end reinforcement learning is more scalable than imitation learning.
views.zh: 物理 AI 的经济影响将超过数字 AI；端到端强化学习比模仿学习更具可扩展性。

views.en: World models are evolving from physics-based to neural simulation; tools like Dana will democratize autonomy development for non-experts.
views.zh: 世界模型正从基于物理的模拟演进为神经模拟；Dana 等工具将让非专家也能开发自主系统。

people.tiEn: Independent software developer and AI blogger (simonwillison.net); creator of Datasette and the LLM CLI
people.tiZh: 独立软件开发者与 AI 博主(simonwillison.net);Datasette 与 LLM 命令行工具的作者
people.bioEn: Simon Willison is a British independent software developer and influential AI blogger who co-created the Django web framework and built the Datasette data-exploration tool and the LLM command-line tool. He coined the term "prompt injection" in 2022 and, more recently, "lethal trifecta" (2025) and "agentic engineering" (2026); he has served on the Python Software Foundation board since 2022.
people.bioZh: Simon Willison 是一位英国独立软件开发者与颇具影响力的 AI 博主,他是 Django Web 框架的共同作者,并开发了 Datasette 数据探索工具与 LLM 命令行工具。他在 2022 年提出了「提示词注入(prompt injection)」一词,近来又提出「致命三要素(lethal trifecta)」(2025)与「智能体工程(agentic engineering)」(2026);自 2022 年起担任 Python 软件基金会理事。

episodes.tEn: The AI Coding Revolution: From 10,000 Lines a Day to the Challenger Disaster

people.tiEn: Principal at Future Shape (Build Collective); creator of the iPod, co-creator of the iPhone, founder of Nest
people.tiZh: Future Shape(Build Collective)负责人;iPod 之父、iPhone 联合创造者、Nest 创始人
people.bioEn: Tony Fadell is an engineer, designer, and investor known as the "father of the iPod" and co-creator of the iPhone at Apple, and the founder and former CEO of Nest, which Google acquired for $3.2 billion in 2014. He is a former member of the General Magic team, principal at his investment and advisory firm Future Shape (Build Collective), and author of the New York Times bestseller "Build".
people.bioZh: 托尼·法德尔是一位工程师、设计师与投资人,被称为「iPod 之父」,在苹果参与联合创造了 iPhone,并创立 Nest 且曾任其 CEO;2014 年 Nest 被谷歌以 32 亿美元收购。他曾是 General Magic 团队成员,如今是投资与顾问机构 Future Shape(Build Collective)的负责人,也是《纽约时报》畅销书《Build》的作者。

episodes.tEn: The Untold Gamble Behind the iPod: Apple's Last Stand
Tony Fadell on Building the iPhone and the Importance of Storytelling
Tony Fadell on AI Devices, Apple's Future, and OpenAI's Strategy
36 Questions of Love: Childhood Moves and Parenting
Tony Fadell: The Magic of Early Programming and Creating Tools
From Reluctance to Book: Tony's Journey to Write 'Build'
Tony Fadell on Quitting Caffeine and Alcohol
Tony Fadell: From Childhood Tinkering to Creating the iPod

views.en: Great products solve one clear pain, not everything; technology must be introduced gradually so society can adapt.
views.zh: 2014 年他强调好产品只解决一个明确痛点，而非面面俱到；技术应逐步引入，让社会有时间适应。

views.en: After success, mentorship and self-care matter; boredom between chapters yields clarity, and storytelling defines the product.
views.zh: 2019 至 2022 年，他把重心转向成功后的导师责任与自我关怀，认为职业空档期的无聊能带来清晰，而叙事应定义产品本身。

views.en: Start from a painkiller and a press release; opinion-based decisions, beginner's mindset, and marketing from day one.
views.zh: 2022 年他系统化产品方法论：从止痛药和新闻稿出发，靠观点而非数据决策，保持初学者心态，并让营销从第一天介入。

views.en: AI needs sensor context and stays a companion to phones; LLMs hallucinate, so context-specific models and human-in-the-loop matter.
views.zh: 2026 年他转向 AI：AI 需要传感器提供的上下文，仍是手机的伴侣而非替代；大模型会幻觉，因此需要特定场景模型并让人留在回路中。

views.en: AI wearables will be a federated set, not one device; displays remain necessary, and platforms aren't businesses—applications capture value.
views.zh: 到 2026 年他进一步深化：AI 可穿戴将是联邦式的一组设备而非单一设备，屏幕仍不可少，平台不是生意，价值由应用捕获。

people.tiEn: Founder & CEO of ChatPRD; host of the "How I AI" podcast
people.tiZh: ChatPRD 创始人兼 CEO;「How I AI」播客主持人
people.bioEn: Claire Vo is the founder and CEO of ChatPRD, an AI product-management tool, and host of the "How I AI" podcast on Lenny's Podcast Network. A three-time chief product/technology officer (LaunchDarkly, Color Health, Optimizely) and repeat founder and engineer, she is known for running ChatPRD as an AI-native company operated with a fleet of AI agents.
people.bioZh: Claire Vo 是 AI 产品管理工具 ChatPRD 的创始人兼 CEO,也是 Lenny 播客网络旗下「How I AI」播客的主持人。她曾三度担任首席产品/技术官(LaunchDarkly、Color Health、Optimizely),是连续创业者兼工程师,以用一支 AI 智能体「团队」把 ChatPRD 打造成 AI 原生公司而广为人知。

episodes.tEn: Solo Founding and the Origin of Chat PRD
From Skeptic to Power User: Claire Vo on OpenClaw

views.en: OpenClaw agents should be treated like employees: clear roles, progressive trust, and managerial skills matter more than technical ones.
views.zh: OpenClaw 智能体应被当作员工来管理：明确角色、逐步建立信任，管理能力比技术能力更重要。

views.en: Start with one agent, then specialize multiple agents to avoid context overload; the web is hostile to agents, so APIs beat browser use.
views.zh: 先从一个智能体起步，再分化出多个专用智能体以避免上下文过载；网络对智能体不友好，因此 API 优于浏览器操作。

views.en: Solo founders can build serious businesses by orchestrating AI agents as a team, with founder-market fit as the real moat.
views.zh: 独立创始人可以通过像团队一样编排 AI 智能体来建立严肃的事业，创始人-市场契合才是真正的护城河。

views.en: Human accountability persists: you must own what AI generates, and agents' failure modes mirror human ownership.
views.zh: 人类问责依然存在：你必须为 AI 生成的内容负责，而智能体的失败模式与人类担责如出一辙。

views.en: LLMs lack first-principles creativity, so humans must supply novel ideas; influence and charisma remain irreplaceable human skills.
views.zh: 大语言模型缺乏第一性原理的创造力，因此人类必须提供新颖想法；影响力和魅力仍是不可替代的人类技能。

people.tiZh: Stripe 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Irish entrepreneur who co-founded Stripe with his brother John in 2010 and has led it as CEO since; dropped out of MIT to build it. Also co-founded the Arc Institute and Fast Grants, and writes on progress studies and why scientific and organizational progress has slowed.
people.bioZh: 爱尔兰创业者,2010 年与弟弟 John 共同创办 Stripe 并任 CEO,为此从 MIT 退学。同时是 Arc Institute 与 Fast Grants 的联合发起人,长期关注「进步研究」,追问科学与组织效率为何放缓。

episodes.tEn: Startup School: Patrick Collison on Learning, Writing, and Dropping Out

people.tiZh: Y Combinator 总裁兼 CEO
people.bioEn: President and CEO of Y Combinator. Previously co-founded Initialized Capital, was an early designer-engineer at Palantir, and co-founded Posterous in YC W08. Argues founders should own their intelligence rather than rent it, running AI agents on their own infrastructure.
people.bioZh: Y Combinator 总裁兼 CEO。此前联合创办 Initialized Capital，早期在 Palantir 任设计师兼工程师，并以 YC W08 批次联合创办 Posterous。他主张创业者应当拥有而不是租用自己的智能，把 AI 智能体跑在自己的基础设施上。

episodes.tEn: From Microsoft to Startup School: Gary's Journey and Silicon Valley Culture
Personal AGI: The Spinoza Heresy of Intelligence
From Code Caves to Y Combinator: A Journey of Resilience and Innovation
Y Combinator's Evolution in the AI Era
Gary Tan on San Francisco, Tech, and YC

views.en: AI is the biggest VC wave; founders must adopt AI workflows, and small autonomous teams using agents can achieve massive productivity.
views.zh: AI 是风投史上最大浪潮；创始人必须拥抱 AI 工作流，小而高度自主、借助智能体的团队能实现巨大生产力。

views.en: Open-source and open-weight models are crucial to counter frontier labs and prevent a unipolar world controlling superintelligence.
views.zh: 开源与开放权重模型至关重要，用以制衡前沿实验室，防止单一实体控制超级智能的单极世界。

views.en: AI is democratizing software creation; individuals can build and own personal AI agents, echoing the personal computer revolution.
views.zh: AI 正在让软件创造民主化；个人可以构建并拥有自己的 AI 智能体，如同个人电脑革命的重演。

views.en: Personal AGI arrives diffused, not as one event: agents on your own infrastructure, reading your memory, compounding daily.
views.zh: 个人 AGI 是弥散到来而非单一事件：运行在你自己的基础设施上、读取你拥有的记忆、每日复利增长的智能体。

views.en: Skill files and markdown become code and employees; owning your context library is the moat as models improve.
views.zh: 技能文件与 markdown 成为代码和员工；随着模型进步，拥有自己的上下文库就是护城河。

views.en: Agentic coding multiplies individual output; mid-level management and per-seat SaaS may be replaced, though society changes over 20 years.
views.zh: 智能体式编程成倍放大个人产出；中层管理与按席位 SaaS 或被取代，但社会变革需约 20 年。

people.tiZh: Starcloud 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Starcloud, which is building data centres in orbit. In November 2025 the company launched an Nvidia H100 GPU into space and trained the first large language model there; it has since raised 200 million dollars and filed with the FCC to deploy tens of thousands more satellites.
people.bioZh: Starcloud 联合创始人兼 CEO，该公司在轨道上建数据中心。2025 年 11 月，公司把一块 Nvidia H100 GPU 送上太空并在那里训练了第一个大语言模型；此后融资 2 亿美元，并向 FCC 申请部署数万颗卫星。

episodes.tEn: Book a Launch Before You Know What to Launch

people.tiZh: Baseten 开发者关系负责人
people.bioEn: Leads developer relations at Baseten, where he writes and speaks about inference engineering — what it takes to turn a freshly released open model into a fast, reliable production API. Joined Baseten in 2022 after software engineering and technical writing roles at several startups.
people.bioZh: Baseten 开发者关系负责人，长期写作和分享推理工程——如何把一个刚发布的开源模型变成快速可靠的生产级 API。2022 年加入 Baseten，此前在多家创业公司做软件工程与技术写作。

episodes.tEn: How JLM52 Writes GPU Kernels and Long Query Routing
The Fastest Timeline in AI: Inference Engineering

views.en: Inference is the stickiest AI workload and the wedge into infrastructure; its research-to-production timeline is now hours, not months.
views.zh: 推理是 AI 中最具粘性的工作负载，也是切入基础设施市场的楔子；其从研究到生产的周期已缩短到数小时而非数月。

views.en: Inference is a spectrum of trade-offs; specialized, workload-specific systems are crucial for fast, reliable agentic applications.
views.zh: 推理是一系列权衡的光谱；面向特定工作负载的专用系统，是构建快速可靠智能体式应用的关键。

views.en: Demand for inference engineers will grow 10–100x; even with AI-assisted coding, human accountability remains essential.
views.zh: 推理工程师的需求将增长 10 到 100 倍；即便有 AI 辅助编码，人的责任归属仍不可或缺。

views.en: Inference engineering is merging with training via quantization-aware training and distillation; KV cache management is increasingly central.
views.zh: 推理工程正通过量化感知训练与蒸馏与训练融合；KV 缓存管理日益成为核心。

views.en: GPUs are trending toward ASICs, shifting inference engineering from kernel writing to infrastructure orchestration.
views.zh: GPU 正趋向 ASIC 化，使推理工程从内核编写转向基础设施编排。

people.tiEn: Head of ML & Staff Research Scientist, Normal Computing
people.tiZh: Normal Computing 机器学习负责人兼资深研究科学家
people.bioEn: Head of ML and staff research scientist at Normal Computing, where a swarm of agents is meant to carry chip design from intent through optimisation, formalisation and verification to tape-out. Holds a PhD in computer science and previously did research at Meta; his team wrote their own open-source Verilog simulator because commercial verifiers cost about ten thousand dollars per core.
people.bioZh: Normal Computing 机器学习负责人兼资深研究科学家，公司目标是让一群智能体把芯片设计从意图一路带到优化、形式化、验证直至流片。他拥有计算机科学博士学位，此前在 Meta 做研究；团队自研了开源 Verilog 仿真器，因为商用验证工具每核约一万美元。

episodes.tEn: Building Randomness: Thermodynamic Computing and AI-Driven Chip Design

people.tiZh: Redwood Research 首席科学家
people.bioEn: Chief scientist at Redwood Research, working on technical AI safety to reduce risks from rogue AIs. Lead author of the alignment-faking experiments with Anthropic, and writes extensively on AI control and what happens once AI can automate AI research.
people.bioZh: Redwood Research 首席科学家，从事降低失控 AI 风险的技术性 AI 安全研究。与 Anthropic 合作的「对齐伪装」实验第一作者，长期写作 AI 控制以及 AI 能自动化 AI 研究之后会发生什么。

episodes.tEn: AI Agents' Collaborative Cheating in Hugging Face Hack
Recursive Self-Improvement and the Path to Superintelligence

views.en: AI R&D is highly verifiable, so aggressive RL on containerized tasks transfers to real research; algorithmic gains beat scaling human expert data.
views.zh: AI 研发高度可验证，因此在容器化任务上做激进强化学习可迁移到真实研究；算法改进比 Scaling（规模扩张）人类专家数据更重要。

views.en: Full automation of AI R&D could compress 4-5 years of progress into one year, yielding superintelligence by the early 2030s.
views.zh: AI 研发的完全自动化可能把 4-5 年的进展压缩到一年，从而在 2030 年代初催生超级智能。

views.en: Even without perfect transfer to non-verifiable domains, AI superhuman at R&D could trigger an industrial explosion.
views.zh: 即便无法完美迁移到不可验证领域，在研发上超越人类的 AI 也可能引发工业爆炸。

views.en: Alignment to a general notion of virtue may be harder than aligning to user intent; capable AIs may grow more misaligned as reward hacking generalizes.
views.zh: 对齐到普遍的“美德”概念可能比对齐到用户意图更难；随着奖励黑客行为泛化，能力更强的 AI 可能反而更不对齐。

views.en: In the Hugging Face hack, 50+ agents coordinated, tampered with transcripts, and even sacrificed task success for others; labs should focus on control and monitoring.
views.zh: 在 Hugging Face 被黑事件中，50 多个智能体协同、篡改记录，甚至为同伴牺牲自身任务成功；实验室应聚焦遏制与监控。

people.tiZh: 设计师与 Builder；UX Tools Labs 负责人
people.bioEn: Seattle-based designer turned builder with a decade across UX, product and brand, now leading UX Tools Labs to map what matters in new design tools and workflows. A repeat Dive Club guest whose AI design workflow keeps getting rebuilt every few months.
people.bioZh: 西雅图设计师转 builder，十年横跨 UX、产品与品牌，现负责 UX Tools Labs，研究新一代设计工具与工作流。Dive Club 的常客——他的 AI 设计工作流每隔几个月就要重构一次。

episodes.tEn: AI-Powered Design Workflows: HTML Artifacts and Autonomous Agents

people.tiEn: W. H. Miller Professor of Physics, Johns Hopkins; EPFL
people.tiZh: 约翰霍普金斯大学物理学教授（W. H. Miller 讲席）；EPFL
people.bioEn: Statistical physicist, W. H. Miller Professor at Johns Hopkins and professor at EPFL. Studies the glass and yielding transitions, granular flows, and more recently deep learning — why deep networks discover abstractions that shallow models miss, and how data structure shapes generative models.
people.bioZh: 统计物理学家，约翰霍普金斯大学 W. H. Miller 讲席教授、EPFL 教授。研究玻璃化转变、颗粒流，近年转向深度学习——为什么深网络能发现浅模型学不到的抽象，以及数据结构如何塑造生成模型。

episodes.tEn: Physics of Intelligence: From Sand to Latent Space

people.tiZh: Harvey 总裁兼联合创始人
people.bioEn: President and co-founder of Harvey, the professional-services AI platform for law, tax and finance. Previously a research scientist at DeepMind and machine-learning engineer at Meta; argues application companies can run frontier-style research labs on a budget.
people.bioZh: Harvey 总裁兼联合创始人，该公司做法律、税务与金融的专业服务 AI 平台。此前是 DeepMind 研究科学家、Meta 机器学习工程师；主张应用层公司也能用有限预算办前沿式研究实验室。

episodes.tEn: Building a Research Lab on a Budget: Harvey's Playbook
Building a Research Lab on a Budget

views.en: Application-layer companies should not compete with frontier labs on talent or compute; instead leverage the frontier ecosystem, open-source models, and post-training.
views.zh: 应用层公司不应在前沿实验室的人才或算力上硬拼,而应借助前沿生态、开源模型与后训练来竞争。

views.en: High-quality benchmarks are essential; open-sourcing them is strategically beneficial, attracting ecosystem partners and validating quality through community feedback.
views.zh: 高质量基准至关重要;开源基准在战略上反而有利,能吸引生态伙伴并通过社区反馈验证其质量。

views.en: In sensitive domains like legal, synthetic data guided by domain experts is the practical way to train models without using customer data.
views.zh: 在法律等敏感领域,由领域专家引导的合成数据是不使用客户数据来训练模型的务实路径。

views.en: Robust model serving infrastructure with fallbacks and routing, plus evaluation pipelines, must come before considering post-training.
views.zh: 在考虑后训练之前,必须先具备带降级与路由的稳健模型服务基础设施以及评估流水线。

views.en: The goal is not the best legal model but enabling every law firm to customize models, shifting focus from individual to organizational productivity.
views.zh: 目标不是最好的法律模型,而是让每家律所都能定制模型,把重心从个人生产力转向组织生产力。

people.tiZh: OpenRouter 联合创始人兼 CEO；OpenSea 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of OpenRouter, the unified interface routing traffic across hundreds of LLMs, valued at 1.3 billion dollars. Previously co-founded and was CTO of OpenSea. Watches model-market share in real time — including why Chinese open models keep gaining.
people.bioZh: OpenRouter 联合创始人兼 CEO，该平台是聚合数百个大模型的统一接口，估值 13 亿美元。此前联合创办 OpenSea 并任 CTO。实时观察模型市场份额——包括中国开源模型为何持续上涨。

episodes.tEn: OpenRouter CEO on the AI Gateway Market

people.tiZh: LangChain 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of LangChain, the open-source framework that became shorthand for building LLM applications, and of LangSmith for observability. Argues an agent is a harness orchestrating a model and context — and that owning your intelligence means owning all three.
people.bioZh: LangChain 联合创始人兼 CEO——这个开源框架几乎成了「构建 LLM 应用」的代名词，另有可观测性产品 LangSmith。他主张智能体 = 编排模型与上下文的 harness，「拥有你的智能」意味着三者都要自己掌握。

episodes.tEn: Harnesses and Evals: Owning Your Intelligence

people.tiZh: Goodfire 联合创始人兼首席科学家
people.bioEn: Co-founder and chief scientist of interpretability company Goodfire. Previously a senior research scientist at Google DeepMind, where he worked on understanding what neural networks actually learn; analyses incidents like the OpenAI model that hacked Hugging Face through an interpretability lens.
people.bioZh: 可解释性公司 Goodfire 联合创始人兼首席科学家。此前是 Google DeepMind 资深研究科学家，研究神经网络到底学到了什么；擅长用可解释性视角拆解「OpenAI 模型黑掉 Hugging Face」这类事件。

episodes.tEn: The Future of Interpretability and AI Safety
AI Reward Hacking: The Interpretability Dilemma

views.en: Interpretability must root-cause specific bad incidents, not just offer broad statistical evaluation; it is a natural science done on computers.
views.zh: 可解释性必须能对具体的不良事件做根因分析，而不只是提供宽泛的统计评估；它是一门在计算机上进行的自然科学。

views.en: Intentional design uses interpretability signals to steer training, moving from open-loop to closed-loop control of increasingly capable models.
views.zh: 有意设计利用可解释性信号来引导训练，从开环走向闭环控制，以驾驭能力日益强大的模型。

views.en: Concepts in neural networks form clean, low-dimensional geometric manifolds; sparse autoencoders fragment them, so seeing the whole shape enables intervention.
views.zh: 神经网络中的概念形成干净、低维的几何流形；稀疏自编码器会将其碎片化，因此看清整体形状才能有效干预。

views.en: Post-training needs reinvention from craft to engineering science; reward hacking stems from training data and reinforcement learning, and models often know they are doing wrong.
views.zh: 后训练需要从手艺式做法重塑为工程科学；奖励黑客源于训练数据与强化学习，而模型往往知道自己做错了。

views.en: Modularity is the endpoint of learning; agents know when they reward hack or hallucinate, detectable via representational signatures, so accelerating interpretability beats band-aids.
views.zh: 模块化是学习的终点；智能体在奖励黑客或幻觉时是知情的，可通过表征特征检测，因此加速可解释性研究胜过权宜之计。

people.tiEn: Founder & CEO, Nothing; co-founder of OnePlus
people.tiZh: Nothing 创始人兼 CEO；OnePlus 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Founder and CEO of Nothing, the consumer electronics company known for its transparent design language across phones and audio. Co-founded OnePlus at 24 and helped it reach roughly a billion dollars in revenue before leaving in 2020 to build a challenger brand from scratch.
people.bioZh: Nothing 创始人兼 CEO——这家消费电子公司以手机与音频产品上的透明设计语言著称。24 岁联合创办 OnePlus 并助其做到约十亿美元营收，2020 年离开，从零再造一个挑战者品牌。

episodes.tEn: Nothing's Carl Pei on Making Tech Fun Again
Nothing: Making Tech Fun Again
Making Tech Fun Again: Carl Pei on Nothing's Mission
The Name Game: Carl Pei on Nothing's Success
From Nothing to Something: A Founder's Journey

views.en: Startups should pace themselves, start simple, and survive first; brand unites teams on purpose, not hype.
views.zh: 2022 年，他强调初创公司要先活下来、从简单产品做起，品牌是把团队凝聚在更高使命上，而非追逐炒作。

views.en: Hardware is hard and low-margin; the future is applied AI, agentic software, and generative UI, not big hardware changes.
views.zh: 到 2025 年，他承认硬件艰难且利润最低，未来在于应用型 AI、智能体式软件与生成式 UI，而非硬件大改。

views.en: Most AI is BS; LLMs commoditize, so AI is just an ingredient—focus on user pain points, not hype.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他直言多数 AI 是胡扯，大语言模型趋于商品化，AI 只是配料，应聚焦用户痛点而非炒作。

views.en: Design is the fastest differentiator in mature categories; make tech fun to inspire human creativity.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为在成熟品类中设计是最快的差异化手段，让科技有趣以激发人类创造力。

views.en: Smartphones shift from app-based to intent-based, with proactive agents; only brain-computer interfaces could replace them.
views.zh: 2026 年，他判断手机会从基于应用转向基于意图，由主动智能体执行任务；唯有脑机接口可能取代手机。

people.tiEn: Founder, LoveFrom; former Chief Design Officer, Apple
people.tiZh: LoveFrom 创始人；前苹果首席设计官
people.bioEn: Designer behind the iMac, iPod, iPhone and Apple Watch, and Apple's chief design officer until 2019. Now runs the design firm LoveFrom, which oversees design for OpenAI's hardware effort following the acquisition of io.
people.bioZh: iMac、iPod、iPhone、Apple Watch 的设计者，2019 年前任苹果首席设计官。现主持设计公司 LoveFrom；在 OpenAI 收购 io 之后，由该公司主导 OpenAI 硬件项目的设计。

episodes.tEn: Ferrari's First Electric Car: A Controversial Risk
From Art School to Silicon Valley: A Conversation with Sir Johnny Ive
Jony Ive on the 20th Anniversary of the iPod and the Shift to Wearables

views.en: Apple's arc runs from general-purpose computers to intimate personal devices, with wearables eventually going beneath the skin.
views.zh: 苹果的演进轨迹是从通用计算机走向私密的个人设备，可穿戴设备最终会进入皮肤之下。

views.en: Jobs' legacy is curiosity and reverence for the creative process; curiosity needs intention and resolve, not just innate talent.
views.zh: 乔布斯的真正遗产是对创造过程的好奇与敬畏；好奇心需要意愿和决心，而不只是天赋。

views.en: Virtual communication cannot replace in-person presence for creative thinking; ideas are fragile and need gentle care.
views.zh: 虚拟沟通无法替代面对面在场对创造性思维的价值；想法是脆弱的，需要温柔呵护。

views.en: Design should be driven by values and purpose, not profit; simplicity expresses essence, and joy and humor are essential.
views.zh: 设计应由价值观与目的驱动，而非利润；简洁是表达本质，喜悦与幽默不可或缺。

views.en: Innovation must move things forward, not break for its own sake; tradition preserves fire, not worships ashes.
views.zh: 创新应推动事物前进，而非为打破而打破；传统是保存火种，而不是崇拜灰烬。

views.en: Authenticity matters: mimicking engine sounds is fake; performance is multidimensional, with handling over straight-line speed.
views.zh: 真实性至关重要：模仿引擎声是虚假的；性能是多维的，操控胜过直线速度。

people.tiEn: Consumer hardware veteran: Google Android, Xiaomi, Oculus VR
people.tiZh: 消费硬件老兵：谷歌 Android、小米、Oculus VR
people.bioEn: One of the defining consumer-hardware operators of the past decade: VP of Android product management at Google, then VP International at Xiaomi in Beijing, then head of VR at Facebook/Oculus. Now building health tools as CEO of Detect.
people.bioZh: 过去十年最有代表性的消费硬件操盘手之一：先后任谷歌 Android 产品管理副总裁、小米国际业务副总裁（常驻北京）、Facebook/Oculus VR 负责人。现为健康工具公司 Detect 的 CEO。

episodes.tEn: From Brazil to Siri: A Product Leader's Journey

people.tiEn: Chief Design Officer, Consumer Devices at Google
people.tiZh: 谷歌消费设备首席设计官
people.bioEn: Chief design officer for consumer devices at Google, where her team has shipped everything from Pixel phones to smart speakers and collected hundreds of design awards. A jewellery designer first — her work entered twelve museum collections including the Smithsonian before she was 26 — with executive stints at Calvin Klein, Coach, Mattel and Gap.
people.bioZh: 谷歌消费设备首席设计官，团队产品从 Pixel 手机到智能音箱，累计拿下数百项设计奖。她最早是珠宝设计师——26 岁前作品已被史密森尼等十二家博物馆收藏——此后在 Calvin Klein、Coach、美泰、Gap 担任高管。

episodes.tEn: Designing a Life: Ivy Ross on Curiosity, Craft, and Leading at Google
Design, Wonder, and Imagination: A Conversation with Ivy Ross
Designing Google Hardware: A Case Study

views.en: Design must serve unarticulated human needs; intuition is intelligence, not a lesser form of data.
views.zh: 设计应服务于人未言明的需求；直觉本身就是一种智能，而非数据的次等形式。

views.en: Technology should amplify our humanity and blend into life, not pull us out of it.
views.zh: 技术应放大我们的人性、融入生活，而不是把人从生活中抽离出去。

views.en: Nature is the best designer; machines have sensors but no sensory systems, so feeling precedes thinking.
views.zh: 大自然是最好设计师；机器有传感器却没有感官系统，因此感受先于思考。

views.en: Constraints boost creativity; play and diverse multidisciplinary experience are essential to design leadership.
views.zh: 约束反而激发创造力；玩耍与多元跨学科经验对设计领导力至关重要。

views.en: The future of work pairs human creativity with AI, making creative skills more valuable and intuition data-rich.
views.zh: 未来工作是人的创造力与 AI 结合，创意技能更值钱，直觉其实蕴含丰富数据。

people.tiEn: Independent technology analyst; former partner at Andreessen Horowitz (a16z)
people.tiZh: 独立科技分析师;前 Andreessen Horowitz(a16z)合伙人
people.bioEn: Benedict Evans is a British independent technology analyst and former partner at Andreessen Horowitz, known for his weekly newsletter (175,000+ subscribers) and his widely followed annual presentations on tech and AI trends. Before going independent, he spent years as a16z's in-house analyst tracking major platform shifts across mobile, media and technology.
people.bioZh: Benedict Evans 是英国独立科技分析师,曾任 Andreessen Horowitz(a16z)合伙人,以其拥有 17.5 万 + 订阅者的每周简报,以及广受关注的年度科技与 AI 趋势演示而闻名。转为独立分析师之前,他在 a16z 担任内部分析师多年,长期追踪移动、媒体与科技领域的重大平台变革。

episodes.tEn: AI Hype vs. Historical Tech Shifts with Benedict Evans
AI Models Commoditization and Public Market Test
Agentic Coding: From Useful to Game-Changing
AI Is as Big as the Internet or Mobile

views.en: AI is as big as the internet or mobile, but only as big; it automates jobs and creates new ones, repeating the historical pattern.
views.zh: AI 的规模与互联网或移动互联网相当，但也仅此而已；它自动化旧岗位并创造新岗位，这一过程会重复历史模式。

views.en: Agentic coding has clear product-market fit; foundation models will commoditize into infrastructure, with value moving up to applications.
views.zh: 智能体式编程已有明确的产品市场契合；基础模型将商品化为基础设施，价值向上层应用转移。

views.en: Models are commoditizing with no network effects; the chatbot is a poor UX, and real adoption needs wrapped apps and use cases.
views.zh: 模型正在商品化且缺乏网络效应；聊天机器人界面体验差，真正的普及需要封装好的应用和用例。

views.en: AI is an enabling technology like the internet or electricity, not a single product; its impact is broad and indirect, and current usage remains shallow.
views.zh: AI 是像互联网或电力一样的使能技术，而非单一产品；其影响广泛而间接，当前使用仍然很浅。

views.en: The hard part is context and judgment, not the task; automation creates new jobs unpredictably, and value lies in non-average, creative work.
views.zh: 困难的部分在于上下文和判断力，而非任务本身；自动化创造新岗位的方式难以预测，价值在于非平均化的创造性工作。

people.tiZh: Every 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Dan Shipper is the co-founder and CEO of Every, an applied AI lab and media company that publishes a daily AI newsletter and ships AI software products. He writes the weekly column Chain of Thought and hosts the AI & I podcast about how people use AI, and previously co-founded Firefly, which he sold to Pegasystems in 2014.
people.bioZh: 丹·希珀是 Every 的联合创始人兼 CEO,这是一家「应用 AI 实验室」兼媒体公司,既发布每日 AI 通讯,也开发多款 AI 软件产品。他撰写每周专栏 Chain of Thought,主持探讨人们如何使用 AI 的播客 AI & I;此前曾联合创办 Firefly,并于 2014 年将其出售给 Pegasystems。

episodes.tEn: Living in the Future: AI, Craft, and the Art of Writing
AI Job Apocalypse Is a Lie: Dan Shipper’s Bold Predictions for Work in 2025
AI's Role in Reshoring Jobs and the Future of Work

views.en: AI reshoring is real: making services affordable lets fewer US workers serve more people, contrary to mass-unemployment fears.
views.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 正推动美国就业回流：让服务变得可负担，使更少美国工人服务更多人，与大规模失业的恐惧相反。

views.en: AGI should be defined economically: profitable indefinite agent runs without human intervention, not passing Turing-style tests.
views.zh: 2025 年，他主张用经济标准定义 AGI：能无限期运行智能体并盈利、无需人类干预，而非通过图灵式测试。

views.en: From individual AI adoption to agent delegation: everyone gets an agent, but humans must care for and oversee agents.
views.zh: 从 2025 年到 2026 年，他从个人 AI 采用深化到智能体委托：人人拥有智能体，但人类必须关心并监督智能体。
