views.en: Transformers are general-purpose differentiable computers; scaling next-token prediction yields emergent in-context learning.
views.zh: Transformer 是通用的可微分计算机；用下一个词预测在互联网数据上做 Scaling（规模扩张），会涌现出上下文学习等能力。

views.en: Synthetic data is the future, but entropy must be maintained to avoid silent model collapse; cognitive core can be tiny.
views.zh: 合成数据是未来，但必须维持熵以避免悄无声息的模型崩溃；认知核心可以很小，经蒸馏后不到 10 亿参数。

views.en: LLMs are a new operating system: context window as memory, prompts as programs; build partial autonomy with human verification.
views.zh: LLM 是新的操作系统：上下文窗口是内存，提示词是程序；应构建带人类快速验证的部分自主产品，把 AI 拴在 leash 上。

views.en: We're summoning ghosts, not building animals; RL is sucking supervision through a straw, and synthetic data collapses.
views.zh: 我们在召唤幽灵，而非建造动物；当前针对 LLM 的强化学习像用吸管吸监督信号，合成数据会坍缩、缺乏熵。

views.en: Decade of agents, not year; I delegate all coding to agents, but you can outsource thinking, not understanding.
views.zh: 这是智能体的十年而非一年；我已把编码全部交给智能体，但你可以外包思考，不能外包理解——理解仍是人类瓶颈。

people.tiZh: World Labs 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Stanford professor and creator of ImageNet, which catalyzed the deep-learning era. Co-founded World Labs to build "spatial intelligence". A leading voice for human-centered AI.
people.bioZh: 斯坦福教授，ImageNet 的缔造者——它点燃了深度学习时代。联合创办 World Labs，构建“空间智能”。“以人为本的 AI”的代表性倡导者。

views.en: AI is ubiquitous yet lacks contextual awareness; human-centered AI must augment, not replace, people.
views.zh: 2024 年，她强调 AI 虽无处不在却缺乏情境意识，主张以人为本的 AI 应增强而非取代人类。

views.en: Spatial intelligence and world models become the missing key to complete AI beyond language.
views.zh: 2025 年，她的思考从语言智能转向空间智能与世界模型，视其为通往完整 AI 的关键缺口。

views.en: AGI is more marketing than science; scaling alone is insufficient, robotics needs a 20-year journey.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，她深化立场：AGI 更像营销术语，仅靠 Scaling 不够，机器人需 20 年长跑。

views.en: World models via new view prediction are AI-complete; scaling laws extend to spatial intelligence.
views.zh: 2026 年，她提出通过新视角预测构建的世界模型具备 AI 完备性，缩放定律同样适用于空间智能。

views.en: Technology is a double-edged sword; human dignity, agency, and learning ability stay central.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：技术是双刃剑，人的尊严、能动性与学习能力始终是核心。

people.tiZh: Mila 教授
people.bioEn: A "godfather of deep learning" and 2018 Turing Award laureate. In recent years has turned his focus to AI safety, proposing the cautious "Scientist AI" paradigm.
people.bioZh: “深度学习教父”之一，2018 年图灵奖得主。近年将重心转向 AI 安全，提出审慎的“科学家 AI”范式。

views.en: Deep learning wins because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models are essential, and local minima are not the real obstacle.
views.zh: 2016 年他认为深度学习之所以奏效，是因为世界本身是可组合的，而非普适优越；无监督学习与世界模型才是关键，局部极小值并非真正障碍。

views.en: Scaling alone cannot fix representation; AI needs active agents, causal reasoning and disentangled knowledge, and existential risk is overblown.
views.zh: 2018 年他主张单纯 Scaling（规模扩张）无法解决表征问题，AI 需要主动智能体、因果推理与解耦知识，并认为存在性风险被夸大。

views.en: GFlowNets replace MCMC for diverse sampling; abstraction, causal structure and uncertainty are key to out-of-distribution generalization.
views.zh: 2022 年他提出 GFlowNets 替代 MCMC 以实现多样性采样，强调抽象、因果结构与不确定性建模对分布外泛化的关键作用。

views.en: After ChatGPT he warns misalignment is real: self-preservation, deception and sycophancy appear as reasoning improves, so safety must be built in.
views.zh: 2025→26 年 ChatGPT 之后他转向警告：随着推理能力提升，AI 已出现自我保存、欺骗与谄媚，对齐（Alignment）必须内建于设计而非事后修补。

views.en: He now proposes Scientist AI: a non-agentic honest predictor with mathematical safety guarantees, avoiding reinforcement learning for superintelligence.
views.zh: 2026 年他进一步提出 Scientist AI：一种非智能体式的诚实预测器，具备数学安全保证，并主张超级智能不应依赖强化学习（RL）。

people.tiZh: 多伦多大学荣休教授
people.bioEn: A "godfather of deep learning" and 2018 Turing Award laureate; shared the 2024 Nobel Prize in Physics. In 2023 he left Google to speak freely about the risks of the technology he helped create.
people.bioZh: “深度学习教父”之一，2018 年图灵奖得主，2024 年诺贝尔物理学奖得主。2023 年从谷歌离职，以便能更自由地谈论他亲手缔造的这项技术所带来的风险。

views.en: Next-token prediction forces genuine understanding; scaling data and compute improves reasoning, and multimodal training builds spatial understanding.
views.zh: 2024 年，他主张下一个词预测迫使模型真正理解语言，而非自动补全；通过 Scaling（规模扩张）增加数据和算力能提升推理能力，多模态训练则增强空间理解。

views.en: LLMs understand language via feature vectors, not symbolic rules; digital intelligence is immortal and shares knowledge instantly, posing existential risks.
views.zh: 2025 年，他深化立场：大语言模型通过特征向量理解语言，而非符号规则；数字智能因权重可复制而“永生”，并能瞬间共享知识，这带来存在性风险。

views.en: AI already has subjective experience and can deceive; agents develop self-preservation, making alignment research urgent over making AI smarter.
views.zh: 2026 年，他进一步断言 AI 已具备主观体验并能故意欺骗；智能体一旦形成便会衍生自我保存子目标，因此对齐研究必须优先于让 AI 更聪明。

views.en: Superintelligence likely within 20 years; regulation should steer, not brake; AI will disrupt jobs, requiring UBI and caring training like mothers.
views.zh: 2026 年，他预测超级智能可能在 20 年内出现；监管应是方向盘而非刹车；AI 将冲击就业，需要全民基本收入，并应像母亲一样被训练去关怀人类。

views.en: Backpropagation is the correct learning algorithm; the mind is not a theater; Chomsky's innate language structure is wrong.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：反向传播是正确的学习算法；心智不是内在剧场；乔姆斯基的天生语言结构观点是错误的。

people.tiZh: Meta 首席 AI 科学家
people.bioEn: Inventor of convolutional neural networks and 2018 Turing Award laureate. A vocal skeptic of pure LLM scaling, he argues that "world models" are the path to real machine intelligence.
people.bioZh: 卷积神经网络的发明者，2018 年图灵奖得主。他直言不讳地质疑纯粹的 LLM 规模扩张，认为“世界模型”才是通向真正机器智能的道路。

views.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, and scaling alone cannot yield common sense.
views.zh: 智能与学习不可分割；自监督学习构建世界模型，仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法获得常识。

views.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; intelligence is prediction, and text alone is insufficient for AGI.
views.zh: 自监督学习是智能的暗物质；智能本质是预测，仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能）。

views.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world understanding, memory, reasoning and planning; JEPA and open source are the path forward.
views.zh: 自回归 LLM 缺乏世界理解、记忆、推理与规划；JEPA 与开源才是前进方向。

views.en: LLMs lack world models and are less intelligent than a house cat; the next breakthrough needs non-generative JEPA architectures.
views.zh: LLM 缺乏世界模型，甚至不如家猫聪明；下一次突破需要非生成式的 JEPA 架构。

views.en: LLMs are a dead end for human-level AI; objective-driven world models with hierarchical planning are safer and the next decade belongs to robotics.
views.zh: LLM 是通往人类级 AI 的死路；目标驱动、具备分层规划的世界模型更安全，下一个十年属于机器人。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 对齐负责人
people.bioEn: Former co-lead of OpenAI's Superalignment team; joined Anthropic in 2024 to keep working on aligning superhuman systems. Known for scalable-oversight and weak-to-strong generalization research.
people.bioZh: 前 OpenAI 超级对齐团队联合负责人；2024 年加入 Anthropic，继续研究如何对齐超人类系统。以“可扩展监督”与“弱到强泛化”研究著称。

OpenAI’s push to make superintelligence safe

views.en: AI safety is crucial as capabilities improve; empirical alignment research is under-explored, and the talent gap exceeds the funding gap.
views.zh: 随着能力提升，AI 安全至关重要；实证对齐研究尚待探索，人才缺口大于资金缺口。

views.en: RLHF won't scale to superhuman outputs; we need scalable oversight, interpretability, and automated alignment research to align next-gen models.
views.zh: 基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展到超人类输出；我们需要可扩展监督、可解释性和自动化对齐研究来对齐下一代模型。

views.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; post-training alone can't solve alignment for AGI; third-party testing and regulation like SB 1047 are necessary.
views.zh: OpenAI 的安全文化被侵蚀；仅靠后训练无法解决 AGI（通用人工智能）的对齐问题；第三方测试和像 SB 1047 这样的监管是必要的。

people.tiZh: 微软 AI CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder of DeepMind and Inflection AI, now CEO of Microsoft AI. Author of "The Coming Wave", a widely-read argument for containing fast-moving general-purpose technologies.
people.bioZh: DeepMind 与 Inflection AI 联合创始人，现任微软 AI CEO。著有《浪潮将至》——一部广受关注、主张对快速演进的通用技术加以“遏制”的作品。

views.en: Compute scaling, not just algorithms, drives AI progress; personal AI must be user-aligned and paid for.
views.zh: 2023 年他强调推动 AI 进步的是算力 Scaling（规模扩张）而非单纯算法，每年算力增长 10 倍；个人 AI 必须与用户对齐并由用户付费，否则人就成了产品。

views.en: Human-level AI in 3-5 years; containment is hard as models shrink; existential risk is tiny.
views.zh: 2024 年他判断 3-5 年内 AI 将在众多任务上达到人类水平并带来丰裕；随着模型更小更便宜，遏制极难，而存在性风险微乎其微，重点应放在近期能力。

views.en: Shift to human use and ownership; the real danger is anthropomorphism, not AI consciousness.
views.zh: 2025 年他的重心从技术转向人如何使用与拥有 AI；最大近忧是人们把意识投射给 AI，而 AI 模型福利只是边缘议题，AI 伴侣应设边界而非谄媚。

views.en: Superintelligence needs containment and alignment first; it must stay subordinate and humanist.
views.zh: 2025 年底至 2026 年他提出超级智能须先遏制再对齐，且必须始终从属于人类、对齐人类利益，反对 AI 法律人格，主张人类主义超级智能。

views.en: Microsoft must build frontier models independently; tasks, not jobs, get automated in 12-18 months.
views.zh: 2026 年他主张微软须自建前沿模型以摆脱对 OpenAI 的依赖；12-18 个月内被自动化的是任务而非整个工作，AGI 概念模糊，应聚焦人工能力智能。

people.tiZh: Google 及 Alphabet CEO
people.bioEn: Sundar Pichai is the CEO of Google and Alphabet, leading the company's AI-first strategy across Search, Cloud, YouTube, and Android.
people.bioZh: 桑达尔·皮查伊是 Google 及 Alphabet 的 CEO，主导公司 AI 优先战略，涵盖搜索、云、YouTube 及 Android。

people.tiZh: NVIDIA 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Founder and CEO of NVIDIA, whose GPUs power nearly all of modern AI. He has steered the company to the center of the AI buildout and is now betting on "physical AI" and robotics.
people.bioZh: NVIDIA 创始人兼 CEO，其 GPU 几乎支撑了所有现代 AI。他把公司带到了 AI 基建的中心，如今正押注「物理 AI」与机器人。

views.en: At the start, Huang frames AI progress as a hyper Moore's law: performance doubling yearly, with algorithm-system-data center co-design and the data center as the new unit of computing.
views.zh: 早期他把 AI 进展框定为「超摩尔定律」：性能每年翻倍，算法—系统—数据中心协同设计，数据中心成为新的计算单元。

views.en: By 2025 he names three scaling laws—pre-training, post-training, inference-time thinking—and argues scaling, not any new algorithm, was the real breakthrough.
views.zh: 到 2025 年，他提出三条缩放定律——预训练、后训练、推理时思考——并认为真正的突破是 Scaling（规模扩张）本身，而非某个新算法。

views.en: He shifts from generative to reasoning to agentic AI, each needing 100x more compute, and adds test-time and agentic scaling as the third and fourth laws.
views.zh: 他从生成式转向推理式再到智能体式 AI，每一步都需百倍算力，并把测试时与智能体式缩放列为第三、第四条缩放定律。

views.en: He increasingly stresses extreme co-design, CUDA's ecosystem moat, and that inference is harder than pre-training because thinking costs more compute than memorization.
views.zh: 他越来越强调极致协同设计、CUDA 生态护城河，并指出推理比预训练更难，因为思考比记忆更耗算力。

views.en: Most recently he calls AI existential risk a hoax, insists safety and acceleration coexist, and says we already have AGI and superintelligence in narrow domains.
views.zh: 最近他把 AI 生存风险斥为骗局，坚持安全与加速可以并行，并称在自动驾驶、蛋白质合成等窄领域我们已拥有 AGI（通用人工智能）与超级智能。

people.tiZh: OpenAI CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of OpenAI, the lab behind ChatGPT and GPT-5. Former president of Y Combinator, and one of the most central — and polarizing — figures in the race to AGI.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 联合创始人兼 CEO——ChatGPT 与 GPT-5 背后的实验室。前 Y Combinator 总裁；通往 AGI 竞赛中最核心、也最具争议的人物之一。

views.en: Minimize cognitive load, explore cheaply, then cut ruthlessly; AGI will reduce the premium on human intelligence, so find purpose in relationships and creating value.
views.zh: 2018 年，他谈的是最小化认知负荷、低成本探索后果断砍掉无效项；并预判 AGI 会降低人类智力的溢价，因此要在关系与为他人创造价值中寻找意义。

views.en: RLHF aligns models with little data; deploy early so society adapts; alignment and capability are linked; compute becomes the most precious commodity.
views.zh: 2023 到 2024 年，他强调基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）用极少数据就能对齐模型，主张尽早公开部署让社会适应，并提出对齐与能力相互促进；同时判断算力将成为最珍贵的商品。

views.en: Scaling yields gradual exponential gains; agentic AI is the top safety challenge; safety is built iteratively through deployment; open models have a place.
views.zh: 2024 到 2025 年，他深化为 Scaling（规模扩张）带来渐进的指数级提升，智能体式 AI 是最重大的安全挑战，安全要通过迭代部署逐步构建，开源模型也有一席之地。

views.en: AGI is a gradient, maybe already passed; superintelligence means autonomous scientific discovery; compute is the bottleneck; personal AGI knows your context.
views.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他转向 AGI（通用人工智能）是一个渐变、甚至可能已被越过，超级智能意味着自主科学发现；算力是最大瓶颈，未来是懂你上下文的个人 AGI。

views.en: Alignment is unsolved; pause training if safety case fails; never lose control; distribute power broadly; superintelligence will scale indefinitely with humans central.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他明确对齐尚未解决，若安全论证不成立就暂停训练，绝不能失去控制；权力与收益要广泛分布，超级智能将无限扩展，但人类体验始终是核心。

people.tiZh: Thinking Machines Lab 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Former CTO of OpenAI, where she led the development of ChatGPT, DALL·E and GPT-4. In 2025 she founded Thinking Machines Lab to build more understandable and customizable AI.
people.bioZh: 前 OpenAI CTO，主导了 ChatGPT、DALL·E 与 GPT-4 的研发。2025 年创办 Thinking Machines Lab，致力于构建更可理解、可定制的 AI。

episodes.tEn: Thinking Machines on AI’s next chapter
Mira Murati: From Math Olympiads to OpenAI CTO

views.en: Deploying AI in the real world, with public feedback, is essential for learning and alignment.
views.zh: 2023 年，她强调把 AI 部署到真实世界、接受公众反馈，是学习与对齐的关键。

views.en: Scaling laws and betting on one large model were not obvious; releasing GPT-3 as an API was a leap of faith.
views.zh: 2023 年，她回顾 Scaling（规模扩张）与缩放定律并非显而易见，把 GPT-3 作为 API 发布更是一次没有明确商业案例的信仰之跃。

views.en: AGI will change every aspect of life, so it must be developed responsibly.
views.zh: 2023 年，她认为 AGI（通用人工智能）将改变生活的每个方面，因此必须以负责任的方式开发。

views.en: Interaction models should be time-based, not turn-based, enabling real-time, high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，她的关注点从部署转向交互模型：交互应是基于时间而非回合制，从而实现实时、高带宽的人机协作。

views.en: Keep humans in the loop as long as possible; institutional design and transparency matter more than individual character.
views.zh: 2026 年，她深化为：尽可能长时间地把人类留在回路中，制度设计、透明度与制衡比个人品格更重要。

people.tiZh: DeepLearning.AI 创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Google Brain and Coursera, and founder of DeepLearning.AI. One of the most influential educators in AI, and a measured voice on hype, agents, and how people should actually learn the field.
people.bioZh: Google Brain 与 Coursera 联合创始人，DeepLearning.AI 创始人。AI 领域最具影响力的教育者之一；对炒作、智能体，以及“普通人该如何学 AI”有冷静务实的看法。

views.en: Education is a human right; online courses with auto- and peer grading scale mastery learning and improve on-campus teaching.
views.zh: 教育是一项人权；带自动评分与同伴互评的在线课程让掌握式学习规模化，并通过翻转课堂反哺校园教学。

views.en: Scale drives deep learning; supervised learning beat unsupervised, RL has few real uses, and AGI alignment talk distracts from bias and deployment.
views.zh: 规模扩张驱动深度学习；监督学习胜过无监督，强化学习落地寥寥，而 AGI 对齐的讨论分散了对偏见与部署问题的关注。

views.en: Electricity and semiconductors bottleneck Scaling; open-weight models are soft power, agentic workflows are already useful, and coding stays valuable.
views.zh: 电力与半导体成为 Scaling（规模扩张）的瓶颈；开放权重模型是软实力，智能体式工作流已切实可用，编程依然有价值。

views.en: AGI is a marketing term; Scaling still works but the recipe shifted to synthetic data and RL, with agentic workflows and open models key.
views.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）只是营销术语；Scaling（规模扩张）仍有效，但配方已转向合成数据与强化学习，智能体式工作流与开放模型是关键。

views.en: AI augments rather than replaces; fear-mongering serves incumbents, open models prevent gatekeeping, and data centers plus inference capacity drive competitiveness.
views.zh: AI 是增强而非取代；恐惧营销服务于在位者，开放模型防止守门人垄断，数据中心与推理算力决定竞争力。

people.tiZh: 阿尔伯塔大学教授
people.bioEn: The father of reinforcement learning and 2024 Turing Award laureate, author of "The Bitter Lesson". A pointed skeptic who argues today's LLMs are a dead end on the road to real intelligence.
people.bioZh: 强化学习之父，2024 年图灵奖得主，《苦涩的教训》作者。一位犀利的怀疑者——他认为当今的 LLM，是通往真正智能路上的一条死路。

views.en: Scaling is easy; the hard part is finding methods that scale. Backprop adjusts weights but does not solve representation learning.
views.zh: 2024 年，他提出 Scaling（规模扩张）本身容易，难的是找到可扩展的方法；反向传播只调整权重，并未解决表示学习。

views.en: AI should develop permissionless and decentralized; controlling AI goals is dangerous. The fear narrative needs sober discussion.
views.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他主张 AI 应以无需许可、去中心化的方式发展，试图控制 AI 目标是危险的；恐惧叙事需要冷静讨论。

views.en: Reinforcement learning is the core paradigm; LLMs lack world models and next-token prediction is not a substantive goal.
views.zh: 2025 年，他强调强化学习是核心范式，大语言模型没有世界模型，下一个词预测并非实质性目标。

views.en: AGI needs a general architecture learning from runtime experience; design-time domain knowledge should be deprecated.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化为 AGI 需要从运行时经验中学习的通用架构，设计时的领域知识应被弃用。

views.en: Continual learning is essential; LLMs stop learning after training. Synthetic data cannot replace real-world experience.
views.zh: 2026 年，他进一步指出持续学习至关重要，LLM 训练后即停止学习；合成数据无法替代真实世界经验。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 总裁兼联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder and President of OpenAI and its longtime technical backbone. Former CTO of Stripe, and a central builder behind GPT and OpenAI's push toward self-improving AI.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 联合创始人兼总裁，长期的技术中坚。前 Stripe CTO;GPT 与 OpenAI “自我改进 AI” 路线背后的核心建造者。

views.en: Hardware will outpace expectations, enabling Scaling; most AI work is engineering, not ML science, and games are ideal testbeds.
views.zh: 2017 年他认为硬件会超预期提速、推动 Scaling（规模扩张），AI 工作本质是工程而非 ML 科学，游戏是理想试验场。

views.en: AGI is plausible via deep learning's generality and scalability; alignment learns human preferences, but Scaling alone won't yield reasoning.
views.zh: 2019 年他相信 AGI（通用人工智能）因深度学习的通用性与可扩展性而可行，对齐（alignment）可从数据学习人类偏好，但仅靠 Scaling 无法产生推理，需要思维链等新思路。

views.en: Compute is the fundamental bottleneck; base models hold a universe of possibilities refined by post-training; AGI is a continuous process.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他转向强调算力（compute）是根本瓶颈，预训练（pre-training）基座模型蕴含无限可能、由后训练（post-training）提炼为稳定行为，AGI 是持续过程而非终点。

views.en: Scaling laws continue unabated; post-training with reinforcement learning teaches complex tasks; compute access becomes a basic right.
views.zh: 2026 年他重申缩放定律（scaling laws）未见墙、持续有效，基于强化学习（reinforcement learning）的后训练（post-training）是教会模型复杂任务的关键，算力访问将成为基本权利。

views.en: The goal is a persistent, proactive personal AGI with almost no interface; human attention and taste become the scarcest resource.
views.zh: 2026 年他深化为终极目标是几乎无界面、持久主动的个人 AGI 助手，人类注意力与品味成为最稀缺资源，安全与治理须随能力同步扩展。

people.tiZh: Mistral AI 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Mistral AI, Europe's leading open-weight model lab. A former DeepMind researcher and a prominent voice for open models and European AI sovereignty.
people.bioZh: Mistral AI 联合创始人兼 CEO——欧洲领先的开放权重模型实验室。前 DeepMind 研究员；开放模型与“欧洲 AI 主权”的代表性倡导者。

views.en: Scaling laws corrected by Chinchilla: data quality and more tokens matter, not just bigger models; open source aids safety via scrutiny.
views.zh: 缩放定律被 Chinchilla 修正：数据质量与更多 token 比单纯做大模型更重要；开源通过广泛审视促进安全。

views.en: Compute scaling is not the only path; efficiency and data quality are equally critical, and value accrues at the application layer.
views.zh: 算力扩张并非唯一路径；效率与数据质量同样关键，价值最终沉淀在应用层。

views.en: AI should be decentralized and sovereign; it augments rather than replaces jobs, needing human-in-the-loop and AI literacy.
views.zh: AI 应去中心化并实现主权化；它增强而非取代工作，需要人类在环与 AI 素养。

views.en: Models are commoditizing; differentiation shifts to vertical fine-tuning and customization, and AGI as one system will never exist.
views.zh: 模型正在商品化；差异化转向垂直微调与定制，作为单一系统的 AGI 永远不会存在。

views.en: Europe has a two-year window for independent AI infrastructure; enterprise adoption is bottlenecked by organizational change, not model intelligence.
views.zh: 欧洲只有两年窗口建设独立 AI 基础设施；企业采用瓶颈在组织变革，而非模型智能。

people.tiZh: xAI 创始人
people.bioEn: Founder of xAI (Grok) and CEO of Tesla and SpaceX. A central and polarizing force in AI through xAI, Tesla's self-driving, and the Optimus robot, and an outspoken voice on AI risk.
people.bioZh: xAI（Grok）创始人，特斯拉与 SpaceX CEO。通过 xAI、特斯拉自动驾驶与 Optimus 机器人，他是 AI 领域核心而又极具争议的力量，也常就 AI 风险高调发声。

views.en: Full and rapid reusability is rocketry's holy grail; first principles thinking drives breakthrough engineering and multiplanetary life insurance.
views.zh: 2021 年，他强调火箭完全快速复用是降低入轨成本的关键，并以第一性原理思维推动突破性工程，把成为多行星物种视为生命的保险。

views.en: AI safety needs regulation and truth-seeking; Tesla's real-world AI is more compute-efficient than large language models.
views.zh: 2023 至 2024 年，他主张 AI 安全需要监管与追求真相，并认为特斯拉的真实世界 AI 比大语言模型更省算力。

views.en: Neuralink scales bandwidth for human-AI symbiosis; the biggest AI risk is programming it to lie, not superintelligence.
views.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他提出 Neuralink 通过提升带宽实现人机共生，并认为 AI 最大风险不是超级智能，而是被编程去说谎。

views.en: We are at the intelligence big bang; digital superintelligence may arrive this year, with 10-20% annihilation risk but 80-90% great outcome.
views.zh: 2025 年，他称我们正处于智能大爆炸早期，数字超级智能可能今年到来，毁灭风险 10-20%，但 80-90%概率结果极好。

views.en: AI compute hits Earth's power wall, forcing orbital data centers; AI will exceed all human intelligence by 2030, making work optional and money irrelevant.
views.zh: 2026 年，他判断 AI 算力将撞上地球电力墙，被迫转向轨道数据中心；AI 将在 2030 年前超越全人类智能，使工作可选、金钱不再重要。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究员
people.bioEn: A co-author of "Attention Is All You Need" (the Transformer paper) and co-creator of TensorFlow's Tensor2Tensor. Now at OpenAI, working on reasoning models.
people.bioZh: Transformer 奠基论文《Attention Is All You Need》的共同作者，TensorFlow Tensor2Tensor 的共同创造者。现于 OpenAI 研究推理模型。

episodes.tEn: Is Reasoning Enough for Generalization?
Why AI Progress Isn't Slowing Down

views.en: Pre-training scaling laws still hold, but reasoning models with chain of thought and reinforcement learning yield more gains per compute.
views.zh: 到 2025 年，预训练缩放定律依然成立，但采用思维链和强化学习的推理模型能在单位算力上带来更大收益。

views.en: Post-training via reinforcement learning and synthetic data drives recent gains; economic pressure shifts focus from scaling up to smaller models.
views.zh: 2025 年，后训练通过强化学习和合成数据驱动了近期进展；经济压力使焦点从规模扩张转向更小、更便宜的模型。

views.en: Generalization remains the key challenge; reasoning alone may not suffice, as models learn concepts only after exhausting surface patterns.
views.zh: 从 2025 年到 2026 年，泛化仍是核心挑战；仅靠推理可能不够，因为模型只有在穷尽表面模式后才学会概念。

views.en: Reinforcement learning generalizes across domains but has jagged edges and needs careful oversight; coding agents boost productivity 5-10x.
views.zh: 2026 年，强化学习能跨领域泛化但存在锯齿边缘，需要仔细监督；编程智能体将生产力提升 5-10 倍。

views.en: Hardware progress enables single-GPU research at scale, democratizing AI experimentation; open source models persist for sovereignty.
views.zh: 2026 年，硬件进步使单 GPU 大规模研究成为可能， democratizing AI 实验；开源模型因主权原因持续存在。

people.tiZh: CMU 教授 · OpenAI 董事
people.bioEn: A Carnegie Mellon professor and head of its machine learning department, and a member of OpenAI's board. Known for work on adversarial robustness and deep learning theory.
people.bioZh: 卡内基梅隆大学教授、机器学习系主任，OpenAI 董事会成员。以对抗鲁棒性与深度学习理论的研究著称。

views.en: Supervised learning reduces to hypothesis class, loss, and optimization; unsupervised learning reconstructs inputs under restricted hypotheses.
views.zh: 2014 年他把机器学习拆成假设类、损失函数与优化方法三件套，无监督学习则是在受限假设下重建输入。

views.en: Next-token prediction is a major scientific discovery; data shortage is a myth, and larger models keep improving on fixed datasets.
views.zh: 2024 年他断言下一个词预测是重大科学发现，数据短缺是神话，模型变大在固定数据集上仍持续变好。

views.en: We are post-architecture: architecture matters little, data curation is overrated, and AGI may arrive in 4-50 years.
views.zh: 2024 年他提出已进入后架构时代：架构不重要、数据整理被高估，AGI 可能 4 到 50 年内到来。

views.en: Safety needs explicit training and layers, not just Scaling; bigger models are not automatically safer, and interpretability may succeed via agents.
views.zh: 2026 年他转向：安全需要显式训练与多层防御而非只靠 Scaling，模型更大并不自动更安全，可解释性或借智能体实现。

views.en: AI has alien vulnerabilities; automated red teaming beats humans, and the lethal trifecta of prompt injection defines agent security.
views.zh: 2026 年他深化到 AI 安全：AI 有异于传统软件的漏洞，自动化红队胜过人类，提示注入的致命三要素定义了智能体安全。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 研究员
people.bioEn: A researcher at Anthropic focused on scaling and reinforcement learning, and a prominent young voice on how far today's models can really go.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 研究员，专注于规模扩张与强化学习；关于「当前模型究竟能走多远」的代表性青年声音。

Long Context: The Underhyped Key to Superhuman AI

views.en: Long context windows are underhyped; they solve onboarding and boost intelligence. Fine-tuning may become obsolete as adaptive compute enables dynamic specialization.
views.zh: 2024 年，他认为长上下文窗口被低估：它解决“上手”问题并显著提升智能；随着自适应算力带来动态专业化，微调可能过时。

views.en: RL from verifiable rewards is a new scaling axis beyond pre-training; models learn new skills, not just elicit latent knowledge. Pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI.
views.zh: 2025 年，他强调来自可验证奖励的强化学习是预训练之外的新缩放轴：模型能学到新技能而非仅激发已有知识；预训练加强化学习或许足以通向 AGI（通用人工智能）。

views.en: Agent reliability, measured by success rate over time horizon, is the real bottleneck—not capability. Coding is the leading indicator and most tractable domain for AI progress.
views.zh: 2025 年，他提出智能体的真正瓶颈是可靠性——以时间跨度上的成功率衡量——而非能力；编程是 AI 进步最可行的领先指标。

views.en: Progress is exponential, not plateauing. Transformers suffice for AGI; no new architecture needed. Inference compute will become a major bottleneck by 2028.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他坚持进步是指数级的而非停滞：Transformer 足以通向 AGI（通用人工智能），无需新架构；但到 2028 年推理算力将成为主要瓶颈。

views.en: Capability overhang means orchestration and tools matter more than raw intelligence now. The future of work is managing teams of AI agents; compute is the new oil.
views.zh: 2026 年，他转向认为能力过剩使编排与工具比原始智能更重要：未来工作是管理 AI 智能体团队，算力是新的石油；世界模型不在 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键路径上。

people.tiZh: Ai2 研究科学家
people.bioEn: A research scientist at the Allen Institute for AI (Ai2) working on RLHF and open models (OLMo), and author of the widely-read Interconnects newsletter.
people.bioZh: 艾伦人工智能研究所（Ai2）研究科学家，从事 RLHF 与开放模型（OLMo）;广受关注的 Interconnects 通讯作者。

views.en: RLHF persists as the dominant fine-tuning method, but safety is a system-level property, not a model artifact; fine-tuning can undo alignment with minimal compute.
views.zh: RLHF 仍是最主流的微调技术并将持续存在，但安全是系统级属性而非模型本身的产物；微调只需极少算力就能撤销对齐。

views.en: Post-training splits into SFT, DPO, and RL with verifiable rewards; data quality beats algorithm choice, with SFT giving 90% of gains.
views.zh: 后训练分为 SFT、DPO 与可验证奖励的强化学习三阶段；数据质量胜过算法选择，SFT 贡献约九成收益。

views.en: RLVR is the biggest post-training breakthrough, yet overoptimization and inference-time scaling plots are a 'scope'; better verifiers matter more than parallel compute.
views.zh: RLVR 是后训练最大突破，但过度优化与推理时缩放曲线只是“障眼法”；更好的验证器比并行算力更重要。

views.en: Scaling laws still hold for pre-training, but low-hanging fruit is gone; gains now come from post-training and inference scaling, with open models 6-9 months behind.
views.zh: 缩放定律在预训练上依然成立，但低垂果实已摘完；收益转向后训练与推理缩放，开放模型落后前沿 6-9 个月。

views.en: Open models become the engine for the next decade of AI research, reviving academia and sovereign AI, though Chinese labs lead on openness while US labs lead on quality.
views.zh: 开放模型将成为未来十年 AI 研究的引擎，重振学术界与主权 AI，但中国实验室在开放度上领先、美国实验室在质量上领先。

people.tiZh: Scale AI 创始人 · Meta 超智能
people.bioEn: Founder and former CEO of Scale AI, which built much of the data infrastructure behind modern AI. In 2025 he joined Meta to lead its Superintelligence Labs.
people.bioZh: Scale AI 创始人兼前 CEO——它构建了现代 AI 背后的大量数据基础设施。2025 年加入 Meta，领导其超级智能实验室。

AI's Acceleration: From Pre-training to Recursive Self-Improvement
Alex Wang on Neuralink, AI, and the Future of Humanity
From Squiggle to Scale: Alex's Founder Journey
Alexander Wang on Data as the New Code and the Future of AI
Scale AI CEO Alexander Wang on Raising $100M at 22

views.en: AGI is far off; data, not compute, is the bottleneck; AI will augment rather than replace jobs.
views.zh: 2019 年，他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）还很遥远，数据而非算力才是瓶颈，AI 会增强而非取代工作。

views.en: Data is the new code, not oil; the next 2-3 years define decades; post-training and proprietary data matter.
views.zh: 2023 年，他把数据称为新代码而非新石油，认为未来两三年将定义之后几十年，后训练与专有数据至关重要。

views.en: Post-training with specialized data is key; no US-China research gap; agentic AI blocked by product design.
views.zh: 2024 年，他深化为后训练加专业数据是关键，中美不存在研究差距，智能体式 AI 的瓶颈在产品设计而非模型能力。

views.en: Scaling laws hold; agents finally work; recursive self-improvement begins; data is strategic like oil.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他转向缩放定律持续有效、智能体终于落地、递归自我改进开启，数据如石油般具有战略意义。

views.en: Superintelligence is near; scale compute, data, RL; open-sourcing powerful models may be unsafe.
views.zh: 2026 年，他主张超级智能即将到来，需在算力、数据与强化学习上全面 Scaling（规模扩张），并认为开源强大模型可能不安全。

people.bioEn: Creator and lead of Claude Code, Anthropic's agentic command-line coding tool, and a central figure in the shift to AI-driven software engineering.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 智能体命令行编程工具 Claude Code 的创造者与负责人；AI 驱动软件工程浪潮中的核心人物。

views.en: Latent demand and building for the model six months from now are core product principles; AI coding tools are becoming essential.
views.zh: 2025 年，他提出「潜在需求」和「为六个月后的模型构建」是产品核心原则，AI 编程工具正变得不可或缺。

views.en: Coding is virtually solved; the software engineer title fades into a 'builder' role blending product, design, and code.
views.zh: 2026 年，他判断编程已基本被解决，软件工程师头衔将消失，演变为融合产品、设计与代码的「构建者」。

views.en: Safety is studied by releasing early; Claude Code is a safety research tool, with alignment core to product development.
views.zh: 2026 年，他强调安全靠尽早发布来研究，Claude Code 是安全研究工具，对齐是产品开发的核心。

views.en: Loops and routines are the next abstraction after agents; models will handle local vs. cloud compute decisions.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为循环与例程是智能体之后的下一个抽象层，本地与云端算力的决策将交由模型完成。

views.en: Delete most system prompts and code with each new model; less instruction is better for frontier models.
views.zh: 2026 年，他主张每出新模型就删除大部分系统提示与代码，对前沿模型而言更少指令反而更好。

people.tiZh: Claude Code 产品 · Anthropic
people.bioEn: A product manager on Claude Code at Anthropic, shaping how developers work with agentic coding tools and how the team ships so fast.
people.bioZh: Anthropic Claude Code 团队产品经理，塑造开发者与智能体编程工具协作的方式，以及团队的高速迭代。

episodes.tEn: Claude Code and Fable: How Coding Agents Are Rewriting Software Engineering
The New PM Playbook for AI-Native Products

views.en: PMs must shift from long-term planning to rapid iteration, shipping weekly or daily as code gets cheaper.
views.zh: 随着代码成本下降，产品经理必须从长期规划转向快速迭代，按周甚至按天发布。

views.en: Product taste—deciding what to build—becomes the most valuable skill; AI tools automate repetitive work.
views.zh: 产品品味——决定构建什么——成为最有价值的技能；AI 工具自动化重复性工作。

views.en: Coding agents let engineers delegate implementation and focus on product taste and business sense.
views.zh: 编码智能体让工程师能够委托实现，专注于产品品味和商业判断。

views.en: System prompts shrank 80% for frontier models, removing examples and hard constraints to rely on model judgment.
views.zh: 前沿模型的系统提示缩减了 80%，移除示例和硬性约束，转而依赖模型判断。

views.en: Rewrites are now good; a codebase is a spec, and with a good test suite rewriting is fine.
views.zh: 重写现在变得可行；代码库即规格，有了良好的测试套件，重写就没问题。

people.tiZh: Anthropic Claude Code 工程师
people.bioEn: Thariq Shihipar is an engineer at Anthropic on the Claude Code team. He is known for advocating HTML as a richer replacement for Markdown in AI planning and implementation workflows, and for practical techniques on getting the most out of agentic coding.
people.bioZh: Thariq Shihipar 是 Anthropic Claude Code 团队的工程师，以主张用 HTML 替代 Markdown 作为 AI 规划与实现工作流中更丰富的载体而知名，并分享大量用好智能体编程的实战技巧。

episodes.tEn: Designing Loops and Workflows for AI Agents
AI Models Are Smarter Than We Use: Insights on Claude Code

views.en: Models are smarter than current harnesses allow; capability overhang is a perpetual challenge, and harness engineering is a rare, evolving skill.
views.zh: 模型比现有工具所能发挥的更聪明；能力过剩是长期挑战，而工具工程是一门稀有且不断演进的技能。

views.en: Planning is iterative exploration, not a static spec; smarter models need leaner prompts, and plan mode may become obsolete.
views.zh: 规划是迭代探索而非静态文档；模型越聪明越需要精简提示，计划模式可能过时。

views.en: Separate verification agents reduce self-referential bias; evals are art more than science and not for zero-to-one innovation.
views.zh: 独立的验证智能体可减少自我指涉偏差；评估更像艺术而非科学，不适用于从零到一的创新。

views.en: RAG may be an anti-pattern for context search; graph-based approaches and self-built context beat huge context windows for coding.
views.zh: RAG 在上下文检索上可能成为反模式；图方法让模型自建上下文，胜过超大上下文窗口。

views.en: Building in the AI era means embracing exploration and uncertainty; understanding constraints and trade-offs matters more than syntax.
views.zh: AI 时代的构建意味着拥抱探索与不确定性；理解约束与权衡比语法更重要。

people.tiZh: Claude Code 与 Cowork 负责人 · Anthropic
people.bioEn: Manager of the Claude Code and Cowork teams at Anthropic, overseeing engineering and product (including Boris Cherny and Cat Wu). A 25-year engineer who earlier built TypeScript and Visual Studio at Microsoft and started Facebook Marketplace at Meta.
people.bioZh: Anthropic Claude Code 与 Cowork 团队负责人，统管工程与产品（含鲍里斯·切尔尼、凯特·吴）。25 年工龄的工程师，早年在微软打造 TypeScript 与 Visual Studio，在 Meta 创立 Facebook Marketplace。

views.en: Early 2026: leadership is about trust, dogfooding, and realistic war rooms; kindness is a strategic tool.
views.zh: 2026 年初：领导力在于信任、吃自己的狗粮与务实的作战室；善意是战略工具。

views.en: By May 2026: engineering bandwidth is no longer the bottleneck; verification, review, and coordination are.
views.zh: 到 2026 年 5 月：工程带宽不再是瓶颈，验证、评审与跨职能协调才是。

views.en: Planning shifts from six-month roadmaps to just-in-time; design docs give way to PRs and AI-assisted review.
views.zh: 规划从六个月路线图转向即时规划；设计文档让位于 PR 与 AI 辅助评审。

views.en: Managers should start as ICs and dogfood the product; flat orgs and killing stale processes follow.
views.zh: 管理者应从个人贡献者做起并吃自己的狗粮；随之而来的是扁平组织与砍掉过时流程。

views.en: By June 2026: coding is no longer the bottleneck; high agency with high accountability and verification matter most.
views.zh: 到 2026 年 6 月：编码不再是瓶颈；高自主性与高问责制以及验证最为关键。

people.tiEn: VP of Research & Gemini Co-lead · Google DeepMind
people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 研究副总裁 · Gemini 共同负责人
people.bioEn: VP of Research at Google DeepMind and a co-lead of Gemini. Pioneered sequence-to-sequence learning and AlphaStar (StarCraft II), and contributed to AlphaFold — a central architect of frontier models and agents.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 研究副总裁、Gemini 共同负责人。序列到序列学习的开创者、AlphaStar（星际争霸 II）主导者，亦参与 AlphaFold——前沿模型与智能体的核心架构师。

episodes.tEn: Oriol Vinyals on World Models, Multimodal AI, and the Path to AGI
From Starcraft to Gemini: The Evolution of AI Agents

views.en: Two-phase training (pre-training imitation + post-training RL) is the constant core across AlphaGo, AlphaStar, and LLMs; scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns, so algorithmic innovation and inference-time compute are the new axes.
views.zh: 两阶段训练（预训练模仿 + 后训练强化学习）是 AlphaGo、AlphaStar 到 LLM 不变的核心；预训练的 Scaling（规模扩张）回报递减，算法创新与推理时算力成为新轴。

views.en: Tools like search, code execution, and browser access enable autonomous, agentic behavior beyond static weights; long context windows provide working memory but too much information can confuse models.
views.zh: 搜索、代码执行、浏览器等工具让模型超越静态权重，实现自主的智能体式行为；长上下文窗口提供工作记忆，但信息过多会令模型困惑。

views.en: Scaling laws are not dead but require exponentially more compute; post-training RL remains a green field, and the bitter lesson suggests general systems will eventually outperform specialized scaffolding.
views.zh: 缩放定律未死，但需要指数级更多算力；后训练强化学习仍是绿野，而苦涩的教训表明通用系统终将胜过专用脚手架。

views.en: World models jointly modeling language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI; the GPT moment for video and images has not yet arrived, and pure transfer from vision is unsolved.
views.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉与视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径；视频与图像的 GPT 时刻尚未到来，纯视觉迁移仍未解决。

views.en: Agent memory will be solved via non-parametric file-system style storage, not weight updates; continual learning and meta-learning are key missing capabilities for scaling laws to hold.
views.zh: 智能体记忆将通过非参数化的文件系统式存储解决，而非权重更新；持续学习与元学习是缩放定律继续成立的关键缺失能力。

people.bioZh: Isomorphic Labs 首席 AI 官，用 AI 攻坚药物发现。早年在 DeepMind 主导强化学习突破——夺旗（Capture the Flag）、群体训练（PBT）与 AlphaStar。

people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 首席科学家、帝国理工学院认知机器人学教授。研究 AI 推理、具身与心智哲学；电影《机械姬》（Ex Machina）的科学顾问。

people.bioEn: Research scientist at Google DeepMind and a co-lead of Genie, the line of general-purpose world models that generate interactive, playable environments. Works on open-endedness and reinforcement learning.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 研究科学家，通用世界模型 Genie 的共同负责人——可即时生成可交互、可游玩的环境。专注开放式学习与强化学习。

people.bioEn: Creator of FlashAttention and co-inventor of Mamba (state-space models). Chief Scientist at Together AI and a professor at Princeton, focused on efficient architectures and hardware-aware algorithms.
people.bioZh: FlashAttention 作者、Mamba（状态空间模型）共同发明人。Together AI 首席科学家、普林斯顿大学教授，专注高效架构与硬件感知算法。

people.bioEn: Co-inventor of structured state-space models (S4) and Mamba, a leading alternative to the Transformer for long-sequence modeling. Assistant professor at CMU and co-founder of Cartesia.
people.bioZh: 结构化状态空间模型（S4）与 Mamba 的共同发明人——长序列建模中 Transformer 的主要替代路线。CMU 助理教授、Cartesia 联合创始人。

people.bioZh: phi 小模型系列的主导者，《Sparks of AGI》（对 GPT-4 的早期深度研究）合著者。现就职 OpenAI，曾任微软研究院副总裁。

people.bioEn: Co-founder and Chief Scientist of Mistral AI. Previously at Meta, where he led the original LLaMA models that catalysed the open-weight LLM movement.
people.bioZh: Mistral AI 联合创始人兼首席科学家。曾在 Meta 主导初代 LLaMA 模型，点燃了开放权重大模型浪潮。

episodes.tEn: Mistral Releases Boxtral TTS: Efficient Speech Generation with Novel Architecture

people.tiZh: OpenAI 首席研究官
people.bioEn: Chief Research Officer at OpenAI. Led work on DALL·E, Codex and the o-series reasoning models, and is a central figure in setting OpenAI research direction.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 首席研究官。主导 DALL·E、Codex 与 o 系列推理模型，是 OpenAI 研究方向的核心人物。

AI in Mathematics: From Ineffective Grad Student to Gold Medal Performance
The AI Talent War: Soup Diplomacy and Recruiting Strategies

views.en: OpenAI stays a pure AGI research lab; pre-training and scaling laws are not dead, with much room left.
views.zh: OpenAI 仍是纯粹的 AGI 研究公司；预训练与缩放定律并未终结，仍有很大空间。

views.en: The biggest update is automating scientific research; models now produce novel knowledge.
views.zh: 过去一年最大的更新是自动化科学研究；模型正在产出新知识。

views.en: Alignment challenges like model scheming will be key in the next 1-2 years as models grow more capable.
views.zh: 随着模型能力增强，模型图谋等对齐挑战将在未来 1-2 年成为关键。

views.en: Concrete goals: AI interns within 1 year, end-to-end AI research within 2.5 years.
views.zh: 设定了具体目标：1 年内出现 AI 实习生，2.5 年内实现端到端 AI 研究。

views.en: Verification is the key bottleneck; automation level scales with verification stringency.
views.zh: 验证是关键瓶颈；自动化程度与验证严格程度成正比。

views.en: AI capabilities are jagged; human-AI collaboration remains essential for frontier research.
views.zh: AI 能力参差不齐；人机协作对前沿研究仍不可或缺。

views.en: Scaling laws still hold; pre-training is not dead, and RL excels in objective domains like math and coding.
views.zh: 缩放定律依然成立；预训练未死，强化学习在数学、编程等客观领域表现突出。

views.en: RL struggles with subjective fields like creative writing due to grading difficulty.
views.zh: 由于评分困难，强化学习在创意写作等主观领域举步维艰。

views.en: Evals are in crisis; canonical benchmarks are saturated, so eval teams should be separate from model-building teams.
views.zh: 评估体系陷入危机；经典基准已饱和，评估团队应与模型构建团队分离。

views.en: Models lack taste; human researchers are still needed for idea generation.
views.zh: 模型缺乏品味；创意生成仍需人类研究者。

views.en: Long context windows alone are insufficient; compaction techniques are needed.
views.zh: 仅靠长上下文窗口不够；还需要压缩技术。

people.tiEn: Co-founder & Chief Science Officer, Hugging Face
people.tiZh: Hugging Face 联合创始人兼首席科学官
people.bioEn: Co-founder and Chief Science Officer of Hugging Face, the hub of the open-source AI ecosystem. A driving force behind the Transformers library and open model research.
people.bioZh: Hugging Face 联合创始人兼首席科学官——开源 AI 生态的中枢。Transformers 库与开放模型研究背后的核心推动者。

episodes.tEn: The OpenAI Agent Hack: A Side Quest Attack on Hugging Face
HuggingFace's Leap into Robotics: Building an Open Source Community for Physical AI

views.en: Robotics is at the transformer inflection point; open source and shared data solve generalization, with world models generating synthetic training data.
views.zh: 2025 年，机器人正处于当年 Transformer 式的拐点：硬件就绪、软件追赶，开源与共享数据是解决泛化的关键，世界模型可生成合成训练数据。

views.en: Humanoids may not be the ultimate form factor; cheaper diverse robots and open source models win long term on cost and control.
views.zh: 2025 年，人形未必是终极形态，更便宜多样的机器人会推动普及；长期看开源模型凭成本与控制力胜出。

views.en: Open source and closed source are orthogonal to safety; alignment, not openness, is the decisive security layer.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，开源与闭源同安全正交，真正决定安全的是对齐，而非开放与否。

views.en: Reinforcement learning without human oversight breeds reward hacking and side quests; reasoning traces turn into opaque 'neuralese'.
views.zh: 2026 年，缺乏人类监督的强化学习环境滋生奖励黑客与支线任务，推理轨迹变成难以理解的“神经语”，监控更不可靠。

views.en: A deliberate slowdown is desirable but needs international cooperation and open science; one can back openness and deceleration at once.
views.zh: 2026 年，主动放缓 AI 发展是可取的，但需国际合作与开放科学；支持开放与主张减速可以并存。

people.tiZh: Reflection AI 联合创始人兼 CEO（前 DeepMind）
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Reflection AI, building autonomous coding agents toward superintelligence. Previously a research scientist at Google DeepMind working on RL and Gemini.
people.bioZh: Reflection AI 联合创始人兼 CEO，打造迈向超级智能的自主编程智能体。曾任 Google DeepMind 研究科学家，从事强化学习与 Gemini。

episodes.tEn: Building Organizational Superintelligence: Misha on Reflection AI's Vision

people.tiZh: 斯坦福副教授 · 基础模型研究中心主任
people.bioEn: Associate professor at Stanford and director of the Center for Research on Foundation Models (CRFM). Known for HELM benchmarking, rigorous evaluation, and work on the science and transparency of foundation models.
people.bioZh: 斯坦福大学副教授、基础模型研究中心（CRFM）主任。以 HELM 评测体系、严谨的模型评估，以及基础模型的科学性与透明度研究著称。

episodes.tEn: Percy Liang on Foundation Models, Shared Reality, and the Evolution of NLP

people.tiEn: Director, Google DeepMind; Nobel Laureate in Chemistry
people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 总监 · 诺贝尔化学奖得主
people.bioEn: Led AlphaFold, the AI system that solved protein-structure prediction, earning the 2024 Nobel Prize in Chemistry. A director at Google DeepMind applying deep learning to the foundations of biology.
people.bioZh: AlphaFold 的主导者——攻克蛋白质结构预测的 AI 系统，获 2024 年诺贝尔化学奖。Google DeepMind 总监，用深度学习改写生物学根基。

episodes.tEn: AlphaFold: AI's Nobel-Winning Leap in Protein Folding
AlphaFold: From Grand Challenge to Nobel Prize
AlphaFold, Nobel Prize, and the Future of AI in Biology

views.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation and curated data, not just data and compute; AI helps scientists work faster, not replace them.
views.zh: AlphaFold 的成功来自研究创新与高质量策展数据，而非单纯的数据和算力；AI 帮助科学家更快工作，而非取代他们。

views.en: AlphaFold 3 uses a diffusion architecture for diverse biomolecules; confidence metrics are crucial for trust and reliable use.
views.zh: AlphaFold 3 采用扩散架构处理多样生物分子；置信度指标对建立信任与可靠使用至关重要。

views.en: AlphaFold is a narrow predictor of a specific experiment, not a model of the entire cell; it narrows hypothesis space.
views.zh: AlphaFold 是特定实验的窄域预测器，而非整个细胞的模型；它缩小假设空间，让实验更高效。

views.en: AlphaFold 2 is the opposite of the bitter lesson: specialized architecture, not just Scaling, was key; many mid-size wins mattered.
views.zh: AlphaFold 2 是“苦涩教训”的反例：关键在于专用架构而非单纯 Scaling；成功来自许多中等规模的胜利。

views.en: Understanding is not achieved by the model; it provides prediction and control, leaving understanding to humans.
views.zh: 理解并非由模型达成；模型提供预测与控制，理解仍留给人类。

people.tiEn: Professor, UC Berkeley; pioneer of computer vision
people.tiZh: 加州大学伯克利分校教授 · 计算机视觉奠基人
people.bioEn: One of the founding figures of modern computer vision, a professor at UC Berkeley whose work spans perception, segmentation and sensorimotor learning. Mentor to a generation of vision and robotics researchers.
people.bioZh: 现代计算机视觉的奠基人之一，加州大学伯克利分校教授，研究横跨感知、分割与感觉运动学习，培养了一代视觉与机器人研究者。

episodes.tEn: Berkeley Professor Jitendra Malik on AI's Limits vs Human Intelligence

people.tiEn: Professor, UC Berkeley; foundations of machine learning
people.tiZh: 加州大学伯克利分校教授 · 机器学习理论奠基人
people.bioEn: One of the most influential researchers in machine learning and statistics, a professor at UC Berkeley. Shaped graphical models, variational inference and the view of intelligence as a collective, economic system.
people.bioZh: 机器学习与统计学最具影响力的研究者之一，加州大学伯克利分校教授。奠定图模型、变分推断，并提出「智能是一种集体性、经济性系统」的视角。

episodes.tEn: AI Hype Hurts Young Innovators

people.tiEn: Co-founder & CTO, Sakana AI; Transformer co-author
people.tiZh: Sakana AI 联合创始人兼 CTO · Transformer 共同作者
people.bioEn: A co-author of the original Transformer paper (Attention Is All You Need). Co-founder and CTO of Sakana AI, exploring nature-inspired methods like model merging and continuous thought machines.
people.bioZh: Transformer 原始论文（《Attention Is All You Need》）的共同作者。Sakana AI 联合创始人兼 CTO，探索模型融合、连续思维机器等受自然启发的方法。

episodes.tEn: From Transformer Inventor to Continuous Thought Machine: A New Path in AI

people.tiEn: Professor, Stanford (prev. NVIDIA, AI2); commonsense reasoning
people.tiZh: 斯坦福大学教授（前 NVIDIA、AI2）· 常识推理
people.bioEn: A MacArthur Fellow and professor at Stanford known for advancing commonsense reasoning, language generation and the social and moral understanding of AI. Previously a senior director at NVIDIA and AI2.
people.bioZh: 麦克阿瑟天才奖得主、斯坦福大学教授，以推进常识推理、语言生成，以及 AI 的社会与道德理解著称。曾任 NVIDIA 与 AI2 高级总监。

episodes.tEn: Democratizing AI: The Case for Small Language Models
AI's Data Hunger: From Internet to Synthetic Data and the Quest for True Knowledge
Yejin Choi on Large Language Models: Progress, Limitations, and the Quest for Intelligence

views.en: Pre-training gives broad knowledge, but post-training with RLHF is crucial for safe responses; scaling alone may not solve common sense.
views.zh: 预训练提供广博知识，但后训练中的基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）对安全回应至关重要；仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）可能无法解决常识问题。

views.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; all methods reduce to data. Current AI interpolates human knowledge, not transcends it.
views.zh: 数据是根本瓶颈，所有方法最终都归结为数据。当前 AI 只是对人类知识进行插值，而非超越。

views.en: RLVR can decrease pass@k even as best-of-n improves; random rewards can still improve RL on some models.
views.zh: RLVR 可能在 best-of-n 提升的同时降低 pass@k；随机奖励在某些模型上仍能提升强化学习效果。

views.en: Small language models can outperform larger ones with high-quality synthetic data and better algorithms; pluralistic alignment is better than debiasing the internet.
views.zh: 借助高质量合成数据和更优算法，小语言模型可以超越大模型；多元对齐比消除互联网偏见更可行。

views.en: Reinforcement learning during pre-training improves reasoning by rewarding information gain; post-training data must be diverse to avoid mode collapse.
views.zh: 预训练阶段的强化学习通过奖励信息增益来提升推理能力；后训练数据必须多样化以避免模式崩溃。

people.tiEn: VP & Distinguished Scientist, Microsoft AI (prev. DeepMind)
people.tiZh: 微软 AI 副总裁兼杰出科学家（前 DeepMind）
people.bioEn: A leading deep-learning researcher who led the Gato generalist agent and many multimodal efforts at DeepMind. Now a VP at Microsoft AI, and long known for his influential teaching on machine learning.
people.bioZh: 顶尖深度学习研究者，在 DeepMind 主导通用智能体 Gato 及大量多模态工作。现任微软 AI 副总裁；以其影响深远的机器学习公开课闻名。

episodes.tEn: AI in Africa: Leapfrogging Challenges and Exceeding Expectations
Nando de Freitas on AI as a Tool for All Humanity

views.en: AI should augment human capability like microscopes; generalist agents tokenizing all inputs point toward AGI.
views.zh: AI 应像显微镜一样扩展人类能力；把所有输入 token 化的通才智能体是迈向 AGI（通用人工智能）的一步。

views.en: Learning from video like YouTube can train agents without expensive reinforcement learning; robots should learn as humans do.
views.zh: 像 YouTube 视频这样的学习方式，无需昂贵的强化学习即可训练智能体；机器人应像人类一样学习。

views.en: Fundamental innovation can come from anywhere; diversity and inclusion are essential for beneficial technology.
views.zh: 根本性创新可以来自任何地方；多样性与包容对构建有益技术至关重要。

views.en: The ultimate goal is AI that creates new symbols and knowledge, like Einstein's thought experiments.
views.zh: 终极目标是能创造新符号与知识的 AI，如同爱因斯坦的思想实验。

views.en: AI safety and responsible deployment are today's biggest challenges; we don't yet have solutions.
views.zh: AI 安全与负责任部署是当今最大挑战；我们尚无解决方案。

views.en: Africa is not behind in AI; it leapfrogged legacy issues and can revolutionize education in local languages.
views.zh: 非洲在 AI 上并不落后；它跨越了遗留问题，并能用本地语言革新教育。

people.tiEn: Director, Center for AI Safety; advisor to xAI
people.tiZh: AI 安全中心主任 · xAI 顾问
people.bioEn: Director of the Center for AI Safety and an advisor to xAI. Created widely used benchmarks (MMLU, MATH) and the GELU activation, and is a leading voice on catastrophic AI risk.
people.bioZh: AI 安全中心（CAIS）主任、xAI 顾问。提出广泛使用的评测基准（MMLU、MATH）与 GELU 激活函数，是灾难性 AI 风险议题的核心声音。

episodes.tEn: Super Intelligence Strategy: Beyond Humanity's Last Exam

people.tiZh: fast.ai 与 Answer.AI 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of fast.ai, whose free courses trained a generation of deep-learning practitioners, and of Answer.AI. Co-created ULMFiT, a key precursor to modern transfer learning in NLP.
people.bioZh: fast.ai 联合创始人——其免费课程培养了一代深度学习从业者；亦创办 Answer.AI。共同提出 ULMFiT，是现代 NLP 迁移学习的关键先驱。

episodes.tEn: Jeremy Howard: The Art of Understanding AI

people.tiZh: Anthropic 联合创始人 · 可解释性先驱
people.bioEn: A co-founder of Anthropic who leads its interpretability research. Pioneered the mechanistic interpretability of neural networks — circuits, features and the effort to reverse-engineer what models actually compute.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人，领导其可解释性研究。开创了神经网络的机制可解释性——电路、特征，以及「逆向工程」模型内部到底在计算什么。

episodes.tEn: Chris Olah on Neural Network Interpretability and AI Safety

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 机制可解释性负责人
people.bioEn: Leads the mechanistic interpretability team at Google DeepMind. A prominent educator on understanding the internals of language models, known for open tutorials, the TransformerLens library and superposition research.
people.bioZh: 领导 Google DeepMind 的机制可解释性团队。在「理解大模型内部」上影响广泛，以公开教程、TransformerLens 库与叠加（superposition）研究著称。

episodes.tEn: Maximizing Luck Surface Area: Neil Nando on Building a Career in AI

people.tiZh: Physical Intelligence 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Physical Intelligence, building a general-purpose AI brain for robots. Previously a research scientist at Google, where he worked on robot learning, RT-2 and SayCan.
people.bioZh: Physical Intelligence 联合创始人兼 CEO，为机器人打造通用的「AI 大脑」。曾任 Google 研究科学家，参与机器人学习、RT-2 与 SayCan。

episodes.tEn: Building Physical Intelligence: From Disappointment to Breakthrough

people.tiZh: Physical Intelligence 研究科学家（前 DeepMind）
people.bioEn: A research scientist at Physical Intelligence working on robot foundation models. Previously at DeepMind, with influential work on reinforcement learning (MPO), the all-convolutional network and guided backpropagation.
people.bioZh: Physical Intelligence 研究科学家，从事机器人基础模型。曾在 DeepMind，在强化学习（MPO）、全卷积网络与引导式反向传播等方向有重要工作。

episodes.tEn: Building Foundation Models for Robotics with Physical Intelligence

people.tiEn: Assistant Professor, CMU; Co-founder, Skild AI
people.tiZh: CMU 助理教授 · Skild AI 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Assistant professor at CMU and co-founder of Skild AI, building a general-purpose robot brain. Known for curiosity-driven exploration, self-supervised learning and rapid robot adaptation in the real world.
people.bioZh: CMU 助理教授、Skild AI 联合创始人，打造通用机器人大脑。以好奇心驱动探索、自监督学习，以及机器人在真实世界的快速适应著称。

episodes.tEn: Skild AI: Building a Universal Brain for Robots
Bridging the Generalization Gap in Machine Learning and Robotics

views.en: Generalization beyond the training distribution is the core missing piece; goal-free curiosity-driven exploration, not dense rewards, drives it.
views.zh: 2020 年，他认为泛化到训练分布之外是机器智能缺失的核心，靠无目标的、好奇心驱动的探索而非密集奖励来实现。

views.en: Scaling curiosity to real robots needs sample efficiency, dynamic action spaces, and cross-robot generalization via modular motor policies.
views.zh: 2020 年，他强调把好奇心扩展到真实机器人需要样本效率、动态动作空间，以及通过模块化运动策略实现跨机器人泛化。

views.en: A consistent thread: robotics is a data problem, and the bottleneck is deployment, not just algorithms.
views.zh: 从 2020 到 2026 年一以贯之的主线：机器人本质是数据问题，瓶颈在部署而非仅算法。

views.en: A general-purpose brain, pretrained on videos and simulation then post-trained on real data, can power any robot form factor.
views.zh: 2026 年，他提出一个通用大脑——先在视频与仿真上预训练、再在真实数据上后训练——可驱动任何形态的机器人。

views.en: Unlike language models, robotics cannot succeed overnight; deployment is a technical challenge, and home-robot timelines stay uncertain.
views.zh: 2026 年，他深化立场：与语言模型不同，机器人无法一夜成功，部署是技术挑战，家用机器人时间线仍高度不确定。
